text: Pax on a B757 advised FLC during deplaning that the wing flaps had received dents and holes during a hail storm during taxi for takeoff. Inspection by company mech confirmed the damage to the aircraft.

Onboard B767-300; disruptive pax interfered with cabin attendants in aisle and stole from duty free cart. Pax argued with and was separated from his injured travel companion inflt. Fo intervened; pax arrested upon arrival at dest.
A B727-200 was operated above the max alt allowed by the MEL manual for 1 yaw damper sys inop.

During a special event at a non tower airport unicom; a texan T6 made a gar near a C172 landing since the T6 pilot had overtaken the C172 in the traffic pattern. The C172 pilot complained that the T6 came over him during landing. The reporter states that he went by to one side of the C172 at 400 ft AGL.
Faa inspector ramp chk of a cargo DC8-71 disclosed cargo restraint deficiencies which may result in FLC certificate action.

Captain of an atr 42-500 overshot final due to being too high and to obtain more distance needed to descend to assigned approach alt. The captain flew through loc toward the other parallel runway causing the controller to intervene and ask for a 180 degree turn back to final. The captain while making the turn also slowed the aircraft and subsequently made a successful landing.
Flc of an acr mlg exceeded max airspd below 10000 ft due to a medical emer.

After a 1 min arts outage to change software; an IFR PA31 at 6000 ft did not tag up resulting in the aircraft entering the adjacent facility without coord. However; the adjacent facility controller was watching the traffic and knew about the traffic before entering his airspace.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: A center controller claims that a BE90 pilot will cancel IFR clearance when issued a rerte around moa airspace and proceed into the airspace. Allegedly; the reporter has witnessed several close calls btwn mil aircraft and the BE90 while in the moa.
Flc of a B757 declared critical low fuel because of weather and hvy traffic delays. Landing was made with less than minimum required fuel.
Flc of an atx piper PA31-350 forgot to contact the tower and obtain landing clearance after being clred for the ILS approach.
Nmac btwn an IFR C310 in level flight and a beech BE36 XING in front at the same alt approx 500 ft away. Reporter had no time for an evasive action maneuver.
A C152 made an off field landing due to fuel exhaustion.
A DC3 on taxiing to the runup area struck a taxiway sign while turning incurring damage to the prop. Caused by the failure of the tailwheel to unlock during the turn.
A cessna T210 in climb at 9600 ft had electrical sys failure due to a severed alternator drive belt caused by a throttle body cotter key interference at high throttle settings.

Flc of a B757-200 failed to make XING alt restr and notified ATC on 2 occasions that they were too close to make the descent in time. However; the controller's acknowledgement both times was not clear as to whether there would be a problem or not.
A pvt pilot in a PA28 enters the slc class b without auth. Aircraft had a defective mode c and had been advised of this prior to landing and departure from btf airport prior to the penetration.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An MD80 in cruise at FL280 declared an emer and diverted due to loss of cabin pressure.
A PA32 instructor pilot makes a low approach without auth from fpr tower controller. Had been instructed to call in 3 mi w but frequency congestion prevented that.
Pilot of long ez aircraft when switching fuel tanks does not completely engage the fuel control valve causing fuel starvation and an emer landing.
Pilot of C172 on bay tour enters class b airspace by one half mi without clearance. Controller brings it to his attention and he corrects.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Approach controller turned an acr B737 on a missed approach to runway 29 at oak to a 040 degree heading to miss departure traffic off the sfo airport and into the departure path of a C500 off runway 27 at oak. Ltss occurred approx 1-2 NM from the oak airport.
Flc of CL65 has eicas message illuminate 'warning right 14TH duct.' while completing chklist; they shut down #2 engine; declare an emer; and return land.
Flc of cpr smt neglects to slow down once they have dsnded below the class b airspace. Reporter complaint regarding the length of atis information.

Faa inspector caused flight delay for the write-up and proper disposition of a faulty cooling machine. Captain obtained mech's signature for deferral of the item after writing up equip discrepancy in the aircraft logbook. Inspector threatened captain with a possible letter of investigation of the matter.
Instructor in C152 with spi in traffic pattern has nmac with a merlin which enters traffic pattern incorrectly and is head on with the C152.

A320 aircraft landed overwt due to a medical emer. Reporter captain's company maintenance released the aircraft without an overwt inspection according to their manual parameters. Flc later discovered that a recent change to their operations manual requires an inspection regardless of other parameters.
A B727-200 on final approach at 2500 ft declared an emer due to a loss of 'a' sys pressure and quantity caused by a failed left leading edge slat actuator pressure line.
Pilot of a PA28-235 had leveled off below the floor of class b airspace but during traffic chk for inbound traffic he clbed above the 1500 ft floor.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Crew received a pilot navigation SID from ATC but accidentally flew a similar SID requiring vectors. Error not noticed until crew turned to an incorrect heading and was advised by ATC.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: A B757 crew uses the minimum fuel advisory to execute a diversion to jfk. When weather causes further delays the crew declares a 'fuel critical' to revert back to their original dest airport of lga.

A C550 citation ii is restr to too high a speed for approach but fails to advise approach controller. Fo slows aircraft when he thinks that the approach clearance had been received. Pic did not advise ATC.

A DC10 climbing through FL310 has a sudden 2 g pitch up exerted upon it. The aircraft's autoplt was disconnected and the aircraft returned to lax. 6-7 pax and flight attendants injured. A loss of aircraft control.
A radar controller at zdc inadvertently issued a descent to a similar sounding acr aircraft level at FL350 and gave a frequency change. Loss of separation occurred with another acr aircraft at FL330.

B737 crew was assigned a visual approach to follow traffic ahead. Captain was concerned about spacing so he slowed and increased intercept angle. Captain and FO were watching different traffic. In the confusion; crew overshot turn to final. Crew corrected and an uneventful landing was made.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: A B727 departing roc; ny; begins takeoff roll too close to a relocated threshold. Flc is not certain where takeoff thrust and takeoff roll are allowed to begin for a safe departure.
Wdb crew had a GPWS 'terrain;' followed by 'pull up terrain' aural warning while on an overwater approach. Aircraft was at 9000 ft at the time. Pilot followed warning and clbed to 10000 ft.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Lta hot air balloon became entangled with a light pole during landing.
A B757-200 incurred a delay due to #2 engine leaking oil caused by the engine oil tank filler cap found unsecured after engine oil svcing.

B757 PIC report on the ATC procedure used at dfw and other arpts for keeping acr aircraft high and fast. This results in a destabilized approach and a possible hazard for other lighter aircraft following behind.

A balloon pilot in a cameron V90 hits the GND; rebounds into a utility line GND wire; snapping it; and then leaves the area. The pilot had lost burner capability due to the pilot lights being inop on both burners.
show: 1998-05 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Climb

text: An sma pilot inadvertently flies over a boat at 200 ft while dsnding to 50 ft over the water near haf; ca.
Physical assault of cabin attendant by pax after takeoff on board B767.

B727 aircraft; still at gate when tstm passed over airport with hail. Flc chked aircraft for damage but found none. Later FLC was notified that there had been damage to the upper aircraft surfaces. They borrowed a ladder from a fueler to locate the damage on top of 1 inboard aileron.
A C172 pilot had an nmac with a C150 while on the entry leg into the traffic pattern at ccr. The C150 was a training flight.
An EMB120 delays its descent when the PF fails to hear clearance. Pnf did; replied to call; then went off to company radio after setting alt alerter.
A DC9 was dispatched with FOD to the right engine compressor blades that were out of maintenance manual limits.

An FBO operator gets confused as to the legalities of the progressive inspection program and flies his aircraft over the allowable time for inspection. He gets ramp chked during that flight but not violated. The POI wasn't informed as to the program's specifics.

A BA4100 FLC experiences a primary sys hyd fluid loss. Pic requests delaying vectors for arrival and requests emer GND equip. He also fills in approach controller with all the other information related to an emer situation but never declared an emer situation.
Unauthorized landing without clearance by an acr light at sfo.
A B737-300 FLC experiences a loss of cabin pressure climbing through FL190. The FO had forgotten to turn on the engine bleed air for the cabin pressurization sys.
A controller gives an MD80 FLC a left turn to get them back onto the airway so as to provide proper separation standards for opposite direction; same alt traffic.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: A C206 lands opposite direction traffic on runway 29 at 1v6; co; a non tower airport unicom. After loading jumpers he taxies onto runway 11 for takeoff; nearly colliding with a landing MO20 who swerved to avoid hitting his aircraft on the landing.
A jetstream commuter aircraft enters taxiway h when told to hold short of it at jfk. Pic cites distr with departure procedure review.

A pvt pilot lands his aircraft on a closed runway at hanover; pa. The aircraft impacts dirt and debris piled 3 ft high on the destructed runway and collapses the left gear. Pilot had suddenly decided to use that airport as a layover.
An acr mlg crew experiences a heading track position dev when they fail to make the required turn as depicted on the laxx 2 SID.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Climb

text: A PIC report on his confused FO and the resulting confusion as passed onto slc approach controller regarding previous ARTCC center restrs.
show: 1998-05 · Other No Specific Anomaly Occurred · Descent

text: An acr BA31 FLC on an approach; during an FAA observed line chk experiences an engine failure. The instructor; chk airman captain took over and performed a single engine landing.
Reporter detected electrical smell on takeoff onboard FK100. Upon landing emer GND vehicle met aircraft and confirmed no fire. Aircraft taxied to gate and deplaned pax without incident.
A PIC report of hail damage to his B727 while it was sitting at the gate at msp. The aircraft was flown and the damage discovered the next morning with a resulting ferry flight for aircraft repairs.

Captain of a saab SF340 (SF34L); had a tail strike during landing roll when going into reverse and touching down on the main gear. The FLC suspects that the tail strike was caused by overwt baggage shifting AFT causing the aircraft center of gravity to exceed AFT limits.

A BE1900 BE02 FO report on a problem with extending the gear by normal means after receiving an unsafe gear up indication on a departure from ewr. The gear had to be extended through the use of the abnormal chklist.

A BE1900 BE02 FO report on a problem with extending the gear by normal means while making an approach to ewr. Initially; it was thought that the gear would have to be extended through the use of the abnormal chklist.

Flc of an MD88 experienced erratic op of numerous insts; including the autoplt sys; during climb causing questionable alt readings indicated via xponder to ATC. Atc approach and center were advised of difficulty. The problem seemed to be corrected after switching to the alternate static source. Continued to dest.
A pvt pilot loses control of her C172 and exits the runway into a field where the aircraft sustains some minor wing damage.
show: 1998-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: An MD80 departing runway 34 at sea experiences a potential conflict with an acr FK28 who was maintaining 10000 ft. The MD80 had been assigned that alt by clearance delivery with departure controller acknowledging the chk in climb to 10000 ft report by the MD80 FO. Tcasii prevents the incident from becoming worse.
Enrte; pax medical emer on board A300 resulted in diversion land at alternate.

A cga LR60 cancels IFR on approach to syi; then encounters lightning and hvy rain on final. The pilot made a 180 degree turn and diverted to fym airport. Later; after departing fym IFR; ATC could not approve higher alt due to other traffic above them. The reporter is critical of ATC for not providing weather reports.
A cpr jet PIC overshot his alt in descent when searching for another approach plate. Stl approach controller had changed the iap to a regular ILS from an lda runway 12 approach.

An FK10 FLC gets an amended clearance to cross somto at the expected alt. The clearance appeared to be a touch late when the controller showed some signs of doubt as to whether he had issued that clearance previously.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Cruise

text: A departure lear 35 from ccr overshot its alt and undershot its heading during a confused; rushed departure. In the course of events they also experienced a conflict with an sma in the area.
An S80 FLC turns past the assigned departure heading when they misunderstand the heading given. The aircraft had just experienced a bird strike.
A B767 crew loses temporary contact with sju approach controller when the VHF #1 volume control was accidentally turned down. A 1 min loss of radio contact occurred; no conflicts.

A320 aircraft on SID departure and shortly after takeoff FLC had tcasii RA directing a descent with target superimposed on aircraft. Flc followed the RA until breaking out of clouds at 900 ft at which time GPWS sounded and FLC saw tall buildings. They continued with ATC clearance and the false warning continued through most of the flight.
An acr mlg dsnds below its clred to alt during a STAR arrival into stl. Fo PF thought they had been clred to 11000 ft; the expected alt on the STAR chart.
A dhc-8 was dispatched with an incorrect warning light module installed on the master caution light panel.
Nmac btwn 2 traffic watch aircraft. One is alleged to have been playing chicken with the reporter's aircraft; an ongoing practice with that pilot or corporation.
Reporter claims a near miss with a sbound C500 at 2100 ft on approach to T47 and reporter's E120 sebound at 2300 ft and after traffic had been issued by departure controller.
A B737 PIC fails to make an alt XING restr when he allows himself to be distr.
Pilot of light twin inadvertently entered class b airspace while awaiting clearance from tracon.

cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A trainee ARTCC radar controller inadvertently issued a descent to a B767 to FL240 with an IFR BE36 at FL250 resulting in loss of separation. The instructor controller states that with 4 controllers plugged in; no one caught the mistake.
A CL65 return land after exhibiting an altimetry problem; thus overshooting its alt in climb.
A PA28-180 comes in close prox to a C152 or C172 in the traffic pattern at eau; wi. Reporter pilot cites distr with radio xmitter and switching xmitters as causal.
A mooney 20C pilot has a mike problem and performs an unauthorized penetration of smx class d airspace. Weather was 800 ft and 1 mi.
An SF340A stalls out at 14000 ft after encountering some moderate turb. There was some distant tstm activity and the aircraft was hvy; with engine anti-ice sys turned on.
An acr BA4101 taxies across runway 13 without clearance to runway 12L. The FO thought he had heard their flight number and a '...to runway 12R.'
A C170 leaves the runway during a taxi procedure with a student new to tailwheel operations. The instructor pilot was unable to prevent the runway excursion and the following gndloop.
show: 1998-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Center radar momentarily provided erroneous alt readout for an acr aircraft in cruise in zhu airspace.
At cruise on board DC10; unexpected turb hit; injuring flight attendant.
An arriving acr mlg turns to avoid a glider which is exiting the fringe of the class c at pbi.

text: B757 aircraft on GND hold waiting passage of weather was hit by hail causing hail damage to ailerons and flaps.
An S80 FO report on a disruptive visit to the cockpit by a cabin attendant who was complaining about company policies; and using foul language in front of pax.

Mlg aircraft reporter captain points out potential for a serious conflict with geese nesting and walking on runways. In this incident 2 adult geese with goslings are on ctrline of runway on which they were taking off.

Acr x making approach into len; mexico; receives a tcasii alert to descend and believes he may have had an nmac. Pilot learned later ATC had clred acr y for approach at same alt closely behind his flight.
Flc of B727 on initial climb has hyd 'a' sys failure. Given a clearance to climb then turn to a 180 degree heading; they begin the turn before reaching the assigned alt.

text: Controller clbed B737 to 14000 ft and later believed he had clred the aircraft to 13000 ft. Controller dsnds a BE90 to 14000 ft resulting in an operror.
Be300 crew deviated from arrival rte in zdc airspace.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Dc9 aircraft had main landing gear tire retread fail and separate on landing roll. Damage to aircraft and engine.
Md83 pilot return land over max gross wt at jfk.
Pilot deviated from IFR clearance when he departed from assigned alt in zob airspace.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Pilot of single engine aircraft failed to comply with clearance to hold short of XING runway after landing.
Pilot of single engine aircraft makes a precautionary landing on a closed section of hwy due to oil leak and high fuel consumption.

Flc of an MD80 noticed that their alt was 300 ft too low at the om during an ILS approach when indicating on GS. Tower reported that the ILS NAVAID was indicating a green light. However; the FLC overheard the tower advise an A300 to hold short of the runway and then noticed an A300 holding short beyond the ILS hold short line.
An acr light flight overshot its assigned alt when the FO failed to use the autoplt alt hold sys as the crew reviewed some flight documents.
Mid wing sma has nmac with climbing B737 and takes evasive action. B737 FLC reports an aircraft dove in front of them.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A B727-200 in cruise declared an emer and diverted due to loss of cabin pressure caused by a failed e&e compartment door seal.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Acr B727 FLC missed note on airport chart requiring approval to cross runway 8R stopway taxiway and almost entered it. Reporter alleges the stopway taxiway e is marked with standard yellow and black taxiway signs.
Pilot of sma makes gear up landing at non tower airport.
Flc of mlg lands without clearance; the result of an unstable approach; weather and a tcasii alert. Error discovered after turn off runway.
Fk10 crew is distracted by the controllers callout of climbing traffic. They momentarily climb above their clred alt.
Pilot of sma makes off airport landing when fuel is exhausted. Faa and police inspect the situation and release him for takeoff with added fuel.
Pilot of sma has altdev due to turb and possible malfunctioning xponder.
A B727-200 on a functional test flight after a hvy maintenance chk during the engine relight verification test #2 engine failed to relight at FL210. Emer declared and diverted.

Captain of an MD80 is startled to observe a free falling skydiver falling through his alt approx 500 ft off the left side of the aircraft's nose during a vector while dsnding through 7000 ft on the dfw bowie STAR arrival. When questioning ATC; he was advised that the jumpers were holding.
While in level flight on approach to msp; pilot receives climb RA and saw other traffic approx 500 ft below.
B767 crew flew the clearance they filed rather than the one issued by the tower. Discrepancy is clarified by sju center.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Climb

text: Pic of B757 has to abort his takeoff when FO sliding window pops open at 80 kts. Takeoff aborted. Had responded and reacted to chklist call on preflt. Takeoff delayed for brake and tire considerations.
Cabin attendants on B757-200 injured when aircraft encountered severe jolt of turb.

An acr E145 FLC had the #2 engine flame out while performing a STAR. They were able to get a relight after completing the appropriate chklists. The reporter complains that the allison AE3007A engine problems have been excessive. In this case; the problem was a faulty instantaneous tailpipe temp sensor.

A BE36 took off runway 32 after hearing what he thought was his call sign being given a takeoff clearance. As the BE36 was becoming airborne the tower said the clearance was not for him; but was for a cessna aircraft with a similar call sign. Reporter feels the tower's comments should have been delayed until he was not in a critical phase of flight.
An md super 80 on approach at 5000 ft declared an emer and landed due to #2 engine failure caused by a malfunctioning fuel control unit.
Pilot of stearman departing at non tower airport encounters a piper cub departing from a x-runway. Distance was enough that no evasive action was taken; but close.
Pilot of C172B is given VFR weather but encounters IMC. Prior to entering class b airspace he declares an emer and is vectored to landing.
Pilot deviated from clred IFR rte. Contributing factor: short 'void' time given on clearance; allowing limited review of rte.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Md80 crew is issued a tcasii ta; RA; and an enhanced RA. Warnings are to avoid two other aircraft.

text: A B727-200 was dispatched with an aileron control tab trailing edge delamination out of limits.
B727 captain; distr by non essential conversation with jump seat trainee; allowed FO to descend below clred alt in zmp airspace.
C182 pilot was unable to maintain alt due to mountain wave in zdv airspace.
A climbing B727-231 experiences a loss of the 'b' sys hyds. Return land mandated. Postflt inspection indicated the shearing of support studs holding the motor to the pump casing.
Hawker 700 pilot missed tower requested position report on approach to ixd; ks. Crew was rushed due to high airspd; and distr by other traffic and landing gear problem.

An LR35 FLC clbs to the wrong alt after the FO misreads the clearance. Departure controller fails to catch error. The captain was too caught up in correcting the phraseology that he missed the error in the readback.
Dc10 crew was unable to pressurize aircraft after takeoff. Crew dumped fuel and returned to departure station. Landing was 2300 lbs overwt.
B737 crew landed without receiving tower clearance.

An A320 loses its automated sys when the autoplt; autothrust; flight director sys and the air data inertial ref sys fails. Flight was flown manually and ATC advised of the aircraft problems and expected altdevs.
Dh8 crew did not follow published heading on STAR.
show: 1998-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Atct lcl controller clred a trinidad to land on runway 15R and at the same time clred an LR60 to land on an intersecting runway 7. Controller realized the aircraft would meet at the intersection and told the trinidad to gar and the aircraft missed by 20 ft at the intersection.

Captain of a super MD80 had difficulty with 2 law enforcement officers' conduct in transporting a prisoner in that they were not boarded first and the prisoner was uncuffed for eating and going to the lavatory. The officers complied after briefing from the captain.
At cruise on board B757; elderly; ill pax required emer care causing aircraft diversion.
Fk10 crew was dispatched to a short runway airport with a landing wt limiting MEL item. After discussion with the dispatcher an aircraft change was agreed on.
Flc of super 80 encounters windshear with quartering xwind on approach and has loss of VHF communication during gar. Two more attempts to land are executed on different runways.
Md80. After being given a poor vector to final; crew overshot loc course on vector to final. They began descent before they were established on the loc.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Initial Approach

text: Fk10 crew was given a late turn on vector to the loc. Frequency congestion and blocked xmissions caused delay. Crew received a tcasii RA for traffic on a parallel runway; and took evasive action.

F100 aircraft on short final hit wake turb from aircraft departing on XING runway and briefly lost control of aircraft. Reporter captain says that; had they been a few ft lower; they probably would have hit a wingtip.
Pilot of FFAX7B balloon encounters wind shift after setting for a landing at 40 ft AGL. Second landing site chosen and prepared for high wind condition landing.
B727. Crew had altdev of 400 ft on descent.
Fk10; and E120. Runway incursion in front of an aircraft on takeoff roll.

Md80. Cabin attendant called cockpit to report a strange noise in rear of cabin. Fo investigated and found noise changed when #1 throttle was moved. At this point #1 hyd low pressure light came on and quantity went to zero.
B727. Company dispatcher changed alternates and sent crew a revised release.

text: A learjet 35 in cruise at FL430 shut down #1 engine due to high engine oil pressure. Cause unknown.

Light crew encountered severe turb on descent. Cabin attendants who did not have their seat belts fastened were injured. Captain had previously made a pa announcement requesting all pax and cabin attendants to be seated; and fasten their seat belts.

Md80 crew transposed assigned radial to depart byp. They were assigned the 208 degree radial and they started to fly the 280 degree radial. This brought them into conflict with a parachute jump aircraft operating 2000-3000 ft above them.

text: Flc of S80 on approach is given caution wake turb and clred to land on runway they had previously requested. Aircraft holding was then clred for takeoff. That aircraft queried tower as to which runway reporter aircraft was using and held position.
Pilot of sightseeing heli lands off airport when engine chip light activates. Possible penetration of restr area while seeking emer landing site.

text: A C421C in climb at 10000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to the right engine failure caused by a thrown connecting rod.
A B757-200 on approach at 4000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to smoke in the cabin caused by an overheated seat audio control box.
A fokker 100 on taxi in to the gate declared an emer and evaced the aircraft due to smoke in the cockpit and cabin caused by the right pack failure.
A departure climbing S80 overshot its turn during a SID departure and suffered a potential conflict with a dsnding aircraft. There was no ta issued.
Flc of B727 is at max wt for climb and remains at wrong alt when climb reaches 0 fpm. Controller intervenes to correct.

Cabin attendant on a super MD80 handed a bill of lading for a hazmat cargo to the captain; during cruise; of which the captain had no official notification. After landing the hazmat cargo was not found on the airplane indicating the paperwork had gotten separated from the cargo when offloaded at the airport of departure.
Pf of mlg has insect fly into his eyes just prior to leveloff alt during descent. Descent below assigned.

Flc of a CL65 with high minimums captain executed a missed approach. Captain concentrated on communication with no assist to FO flying. They had difficulty setting up for entry to the hold; configuring the aircraft; and they overspeed the aircraft for flap setting. On second try a runway change created more cockpit confusion but approach and landing accomplished.
Flc of a fokker 100 FK10 stopped their arrival descent and clbed in response to a tcasii of a cessna 210 passing below.

text: A B767-300 FLC forgets to advise oceanic clearance delivery of the fact that they had their oceanic clearance which had been received by datalink.

A cpr HS25 taxiing to hangar was told to hold short of runway 35; then clred to cross the runway; saw an AC6T enter runway 35 at taxiway k and start his takeoff. The HS25 held clear of the runway; but over the hold line. Hs25 captain talked to the tower later and asked for tapes to be held.

A DC9-30 on engine start #2 engine failed to start due to ignition sys not selected on resulting in a tailpipe fire. With #1 engine running the crew was advised by the GND personnel the left engine had a fire. Crew pulled firewall shutoffs for both engines and evaced the aircraft.
Fo of an acr turboprop failed to intercept clearance radial during departure climb resulting in controller intervention to direct reporter's aircraft on course.

text: An acr aircraft being vectored for a visual approach to runway 19L missed a turn clearance and had an nmac with a cessna. Tcasii alerted the acr FLC and they reacted to the RA.
A B727 freighter PIC allows a wingtip to strike the GND during a low visibility approach and subsequent missed approach after aircraft loses alignment with the runway.

A BE02 FLC departs airport with less fuel than required. Airline fueling procedure allows hand signals from captain to fueler for amount of fuel to be placed on board. Flight returns to departure airport.

A taxiing B727 freighter has a smoking brake after landing and that fact is reported to the crew and tower by a following aircraft. Emer GND equip is dispatched as a precaution. The crew fails to write up the cause of the emer conditions after an inspection is performed.
Instructor with spi on pattern entry has nmac with second aircraft making an improper pattern entry.

A B757 dsnding into lax receives a tcasii RA from an aircraft following. The B757 executes a missed approach when his tcasii indicates an RA. B757 makes an uneventful landing after executing his missed approach.

New airspace in effect at gso caused some confusion resulting in a departure being clred initially to 3000 ft and not reclred to cross above an obstruction.
Dc9 too hvy for alt. Crew declares an emer and turns off track to descend in zid airspace.
A B747-400 FO misreads their fans message for an alt change and leaves FL310 for FL330 at too early a time. Pic then reads message and goes back to FL310.

Pvt pilot of a C210 failed to contact GND control during taxi to parking after landing. Pilot was given clearance by lcl control after landing but subsequently failed to guard GND control due to the landing gear warning horn sounding during taxi.

An MD88 flying through atl; GA; airspace is vectored towards a tstm. When FLC discovers they are not going to clear the storm; FLC takes up new heading on their own without any clearance from ATC. Aircraft is turned steeply enough that all occupants feel the extra 'g' force of the turn.
A DC9 skids off the end of runway 8L at atl airport onto the overrun. The rubber deposits on the end of reciprocal runway 26R were rain soaked and provided no traction for low speed braking.
show: 1998-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of DC9 is informed prior to departure that there is possible windshear off the end of the runway with tstms apching from e and w. They depart and encounter severe turb for 15-20 minutes.
Instructor with inst student in a C172 making an inst approach has a stuck mike. This creates a problem of ltss for the approach controller.
Flc of a super MD80 declared an emer and dsnded when their aircraft could not maintain a safe flying speed at assigned cruise alt due to the aircraft gross wt.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: Jet transport crew misinterprets clearance. Clbs through assigned alt in phl airspace.
An md super 80 was returned to svc from a hvy 'c' chk with numerous sys malfunctions and incomplete maintenance.

A300 aircraft prior to departure cargo handlers failed to secure a cargo bin which shifted during flight making a thumping sound. Cabin attendants reported the sound to the cockpit; but the bin wasn't accessible until landing at dest.

Flc of a B757 used vectors and vortac direct navigation after noticing faulty indications and actions of the aircraft's FMS during departure climb from a foreign airport. The cause was suspected to have been caused by pax use of an electronic computer game.

Flc of a falcon 50 DA50 lost directional control of the aircraft during landing and went off the side of the runway damaging a runway edge light. There was no other damage to the aircraft except a blown outside main gear tire. The failure of the outboard wheel anti-skid caused the wheel to lock up when the brakes were applied.
show: 1998-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Pilot of a beech bonanza BE36 failed to turn to heading as instructed by departure resulting in the controller intervening by giving another heading to avoid a mil base. The reporter was distr by his pax and forgot to reset the HSI heading mode from gps to VOR.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: Md90; a departure off oma; was instructed to turn left after takeoff and while turning encountered a B727 making an ILS approach from the opposite end.
Instructor pilot of a piper PA28-180 became caught in marginal VFR weather conditions when returning from a lcl demonstration flight to a prospective student.

A C152 assigned 3500 ft passing near sna airport observed a B737 depart sna and turn toward his position. The tower instructed the B737 to maintain 3000 ft for separation; but the C152 pilot; apparently unaware ATC was providing separation; continued descent below 3500 ft in an attempt to avoid the B737. The pilots on the B737 were required to take evasive action on a tcasii RA and a visual on the C152.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Upon departure on board MD80S; 2 pax seat backs discovered inop on a full flight resulting in divert for maintenance.
Reporter claims N90 tracon did not notify lcl twrs that ids-4 was no longer being updated due to lack of staffing. On one occasion; an aircraft was issued an incorrect routing as a result.
Flc of a cpr jet failed to obtain landing clearance due to distrs of aircraft equip problem; traffic watch and a high close in visual approach through a broken layer of clouds.
Captain of a B727 struck the right wing and flap when making a missed approach in low visibility conditions. Damage to the aircraft was discovered the next day.

B767-300 aircraft on atlantic oceanic rte at FL340 was passed by a B747 at FL350. Approx 30-40 mi in trail of the B747 reporter aircraft experienced wake turb which immediately put the aircraft in a 15 degree right bank. Reporter captain altered course to the right; then dsnded 250 ft and altered back to a left offset due to wind direction.

Flc of a super MD80 stopped their visual approach for landing and clbed in response to a tcasii RA. Evasive action was taken even though ATC had issued a ta of the cessna aircraft since it was not sighted.
Pilot of c182rg hurries through runup procedures and does not set his directional gyro. Departing; he turns wrong direction and enters restr airspace.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: An MD88; after pushback and engine start with the tug connected; rolled forward. No damage incurred.
Pilot of a mooney mite failed to contact GND control leaving the runway after landing resulting in taxiing on taxiways; and XING a parallel runway approach overrun area without clearance.

An md super 80 on arrival tracks at FL310 experienced erratic ADF indications from both sys. Cabin chk revealed 2 laptop computers; 4 cd players; 4 cassette players; and 1 personal video computer in op.
Reported situation of reporter's F100 at touchdown when a departing aircraft was rotating on the same runway.

A DC10-10 immediately after takeoff at 3000 ft declared an emer; dumped fuel and returned to the field due to unable to pressurize the aircraft caused by a failed cabin door seal. Aircraft landed overwt.
Reported situation in which the reporter's aircraft at a faster speed was spaced too closely behind a preceding aircraft.
Reporter alleges the approach controller did not coord with the lcl controller that reporter was unable to accept lahso operations.
A climbing L1011-500 experiences an alt undershoot when the FMC does not capture the climb to alt. Aircraft slowly dsnded until ATC controller corrected situation.

When FLC of an acr turboprop reported in after takeoff from an unctled airport; ARTCC radar controller advised that they had exceeded their clearance void time. The FLC believed that they took off at void time which was within legal limits.

Pilot of a commander 114 (AC14) inadvertently flew through a parachute jump zone during a parachute jump. Reporter first noticed aircraft diving down in front of him and then several parachutes open several thousand ft below. He was receiving flight following from ARTCC and was advised about the incursion from ARTCC after the jump aircraft pilot exclaimed about his intruding aircraft.

Flc of a B757 diverted to land after a flight attendant was injured during svc to pax when hitting a pax seat with his knee causing him a dislocated knee cap. Flc declared a lifeguard flight in order to receive priority handling.
A canadair CL65 in climb at FL260 declared an emer and diverted due to a main cabin door warning.
A B727 PIC incurs a tail strike during a xwind takeoff at dtw.
A DC9-10 returned to the field due to loss of #2 engine oil caused by an oil filler cap seal cut during installation.
Pilot of a piper cherokee; PA28-200; landed gear up after declaring an emer due to loss of engine oil pressure.
Flc of a saab SF340B (SF34L); dsnded in response to a tcasii RA. A false tcasii warning is believed possible by the crew since ATC showed no traffic in their vicinity nor did the crew sight traffic.
A B737-700 crew overshot their assigned alt; believing that their autoplt is coupled. It wasn't; maintenance had disengaged both autoplts prior to the flight.
An S80 departing sna encounters wake turb behind a B757. Wake effect is light causing very slight roll. No control problems occurred.

During climb; acr pilot received a tcasii RA and sees the other aircraft pass opposite direction below his alt. According to reporter; controller stated he was working the other aircraft in level flight.

An LR24 experiences a double engine flameout when the crew allows the aircraft to fly through the top of an undetected tstm during a night op. The aircraft encounters turb just prior to the first of the engines flaming out. The aircraft's radar was not on.
At cruise on MD80S; pax had heart attack. Physicians that happened to be on board assisted ill pax.

An acr mlg PIC suffers a tail strike on takeoff. The FO fails in all of his CRM efforts to get the PIC to return land for inspection. At dest airport the FO has to finally get maintenance involved for the captain to write up the tail strike. Captain now on suspension from company.

After the B727 was deplaned at the arrival gate; a flight attendant notifies the FO that a pax is thought to be dead. Paramedics confirm the pax's condition. Captain notifies company and the aircraft is then flown out empty on a repositioning flight. Faa tells dispatcher later that they were concerned with the aircraft's departure since crew had not called the FAA.
Pvt pilot in a BE35 flies into a restr area without clearance. He was running beneath the clouds and did not recognize the correct hwy for his positional awareness.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A BE55 pilot makes a nose gear up landing when unable to extend the nose gear by any means. Night op. Pilot lauds simulator recurrent training program.
A C414 FLC overshot their assigned alt when the crew did not read back the correct clearance to ZKC. Controller missed erroneous readback.
Acr departure off sdf airport receives ta from controller and a tcasii RA about the same time.
L1011 while being guided off a gate for repositioning struck a parked jetway incurring damage to the left wingtip and strobe light.

An L1011 on approach to lax runway 25R was advised to keep acr y B757 in sight making a visual approach to runway 25L and 'not to pass it'. The L1011 gained on the B757 and passed it 1.5 mi from touchdown when the B757 slowed for landing. L1011 crew was asked to call the tower supvr who later said the fac operation 'was legal.'

After canceling an IFR flight plan; pilot of mooney M20J landed at the wrong airport. The arpts were similarly situated in line with each other in the same direction. Approach controller stated that the reporter's intended airport was at his 12 o'clock position and reporter replied that he had it in sight. However; it was closer to him than his intended airport.
Pilot of acr received tcasii RA during climb and took evasive action. Traffic was apparently an unctled small aircraft.

Captain of a wdb taxied off the landing runway on a reverse high speed at cdg; resulting in tower GND controller advising that this was prohibited. Subsequent review of the airport diagram had a note to this effect.

Pilot receiving instruction in tailwheel type aircraft lost directional control of the aircraft during fast taxi on a runway resulting in going off the side of the runway and GND looping. The aircraft's left main gear; wingtip and elevator were damaged. The FAA investigated this incident and classified it as an incident.
show: 1998-05 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Parked

text: Captain of an MD88 turned early for a noise abatement departure restr.

Dhc-8 FLC complies with taxi clearance to hold short of taxiway e for a B767 on taxiway e and turning in front of them. Holding in compliance with hold line position they are almost hit by the wing of the fast taxiing B767.
A FLC on an acr DC9-80 experiences a dev from the airway when the PIC is distr by an AFT cabin door warning light. They overcome that problem while ATC gives them a 'heads up' as to their position.
Alt excursion during high alt cruise by FLC of an MD11.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: H1p pilot inadvertently penetrated P56-a airspace while on a photographic mission.
show: 1998-05 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Captain of a B737-200 overshot the runway hold line while attempting to turn out of departure line-up onto a taxiway for holding to contact company maintenance. Reporter advised the tower of the overshoot and tower instructed them to determine with the FLC of B747 in position for takeoff if it would interfere with their takeoff. Both flcs decided that it would not interfere.

Reporter claims tower controller aborted acr takeoff and instructed acr on final to execute a gar. The controller allegedly then clred the acr again for takeoff and instructed a second acr on final to make a gar.
C177 pilot flew into IMC conditions while on a VFR flight plan.
A BAE3200 FLC in stl experiences an unauthorized runway entry while attempting to deal with the aftermath of an aborted takeoff.

Nmac btwn an sel sma katana and a C182 both climbing out from departure runway at approx 1200 ft MSL. The C182 overtook the katana and made an evasive action turn to avoid the reporter who was making rolling banks to the right and left. The C182 pilot may have been alarmed as to what direction the katana would end up going because of its 45 degree banking turns.
A B727-200 on takeoff from rno; nv; encounters a GPWS as it clbs to a higher alt. A hill 600 ft AGL and surrounding terrain is close to the GND track of the departing aircraft.
Flc of a cpr learjet 35; overshot assigned alt during climb due to weather avoidance and lack of autoplt alt preset mode equip feature.
A B737-300 in climb at 13500 ft declared an emer and diverted due to inability to control cabin pressurization in any mode.
A DC9-30 on returning to the gate after a 2 pt 5 hr GND hold declared an emer and evaced the aircraft due to a wing vent tank fuel spillage.
A B737-300 was dispatched with the e&e compartment door closed but not locked causing the cabin to not pressurize on takeoff.

While in the arrival phase apching sea; FLC believes clearance to descend to 5000 ft was issued by the controller. After crew received a tcasii ta and an RA; the controller advised clearance to 7000 ft had been issued.

Pilot of an sma twin during a practice single engine approach had both props; the right flap; and entrance step strike the runway during a gar. Reporter chk pilot stated that the aircraft attitude was not correct for landing and a scraping noise was heard during the gar. A diversion to an alternate airport with emer GND equip available was made since the amount of aircraft damage was unknown.
Pilot of a pvt hughes 269A heli penetrated class d mil airspace enrte to nearby civil airport for fuel.
show: 1998-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flight school instructor indicates a wrong approach control frequency on the sac charts. The frequency was changed about 10 yrs ago but is still published.
On board A300; drunk obnoxious pax disrupted flight; disobeyed emer regs; threatened cabin attendant and attempted to open cockpit door and upon arrival was dismissed by auths.
An acr LR24 freighter FLC experienced a double flameout while flying over a tstm at FL410. They got their first engine relit at 13000 ft and were able to recover and continue to dest.

Pvt pilot of an sel sma drifted off track during an IFR IMC flight due to changeable wind conditions in weather; resulting in approach controller intervention to not only bring reporter back to course; but provide vectors to stay outside of class b airspace.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Cruise

text: An mlg commercial fixed wing aircraft; after pushback and engine start; the tow bar was disconnected and towed 90 degrees to the nose tire incurring damage to the tow bar.

Flc of a B757 started descent on a STAR arrival per ARTCC clearance; and the controller intervened after they had dsnded 600 ft to ask them why they were dsnding. After their reply that the controller had clred them; the controller clred them on down to a lower alt.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: A B727-200 in climb at FL220 returned to the field due to loss of b hyd sys pressure and quantity caused by a cracked b pump case.

Alt excursion by a B747 on a foreign country SID. The FLC caught the drift off alt; as well as ATC; and were advised that there was another aircraft assigned 1000 ft above their alt. The FO made a manual; immediate correction.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: Pilot of a piper PA31-350; declared an emer and returned to land during clbout due to catastrophic right engine failure with accompanying engine fire.

New FO of an acr light made approach to wrong airport due to chk captain distr when clred by ATC for a visual approach. Approach controller intervened and advised them of error and directed them back to dest airport.
show: 1998-05 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Descent

text: Pilot departs after refueling and has fuel siphoning. Makes a return to base and determines fuel cap is missing.
Pilot of maule MXT7-180A lands at closed airport and is ticketed by park ranger. This airport is not shown on sectional chart and is unknown to fss.

After FLC of an acr mlg was given a clearance to a higher alt; departure controller advised that such a clearance had not been given during their climb and for them to return to their original alt. When the FLC queried ATC; another controller said that there had been controller confusion due to weather and hvy traffic; and that there had been no conflict with reporter's flight.

Pilot of a cpr smt turboprop took off over a C210 that had just taxied into position for takeoff at the other end of the runway during the reporter's takeoff roll. The airport was unctled and the C210 pilot was not heard making calls on the lcl unicom frequency.
While making IFR approach to vrb airport; pilot; aircraft x; spots VFR traffic; aircraft y; ahead on base leg. Controller sequences aircraft x #2 to follow aircraft y.
Pvt pilot of a C172 made an off airport forced landing due to engine fuel starvation. There were no injuries or damage to the aircraft.
A B737-300 taxies into the ramp area at slc looking for a designated spot to taxi to. The spot visibility is so poor the FLC taxies past the designated spot.

Aircraft x departs bwi airport; is on SID and on ARTCC frequency. Controller #1 issues pilot heading to intercept airway and changes aircraft to controller #2. Pilot misunderstands clearance and crosses airway to conflict with aircraft y.

Pilot of a C402C dsnded form assigned alt in anticipation of receiving a visual approach. However; approach controller denied his request and reminded the reporter to maintain assigned alt. Reporter returned to assigned to wait for iap clearance.
show: 1998-05 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Descent

text: An acr B737 FLC had a conflict with a C182 as they were climbing out after takeoff. The controller; apparently; admitted fault.
Sel sma penetrated class b airspace during a pilot inst training flight due to a misunderstanding btwn the instructor and a tower controller.
show: 1998-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: A B737-300 in climb at 8000 ft returned to the field due to failure of the left air-conditioning pack and with the mistaken impression the right air-conditioning pack was also deferred inop.

Nmac btwn a light aircraft and an airline F28 10 mi nw of bzn; mt. The GA aircraft was intercepting the loc and the F28 had just called in to the unicom at bzn. The instructor pilot noted the F28 when he passed by at 300 ft. Xponder not on in the GA aircraft.
Maui atct occasionally unable to pick up data blocks on traffic handed off to them by approach control.

Acr x departs dtw runway on runway 21L with clearance instructions to turn left after takeoff. Apparently before starting left turn; the crew observed acr y; presumably on their right; flying toward and over their position.
A B727 PIC taxies past the hold short line on taxiway n and performs an incursion into taxiway d thus creating a hazard for a taxiing A330. Night op.

Zmp controller receives handoff from msp approach on aircraft x. On initial contact; zmp controller issues higher alt; at pilot's request. Msp forgets to point out aircraft y above aircraft x resulting in an operror.

Dc9-30 aircraft instructed to contact ATC on another frequency. Flc wrote down the wrong frequency and unable to establish contact; then forgot for awhile. Then looked up frequency off charts and re-established communication.
A BE1900 on takeoff roll at 40-60 kts had the main cabin door open with no door warning annunciation which later proved inop.
A DC9 parked at the gate declared an emer due to a report from the GND crew of a fire in the APU area. Aircraft was evaced and APU area chked and found no evidence of fire. Apu op ok.
B727 aircraft in cruise; FLC distracted by rmi indication; autoplt didn't hold alt and aircraft clbed 500 ft before ATC controller caught alt dev.
show: 1998-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: Alt excursion in ztl airspace.
show: 1998-06 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A PA34-200 on a touch-and-go maneuver experienced the right engine fail at start of liftoff. Aircraft veered right and exited the runway incurring minor aircraft damage.
show: 1998-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Flc of a B737-200 overshot descent alt due to aircraft equip problem distr and then discovered their error and returned immediately. They were then clred to a lower alt.
Lear 25 crew misses XING alt restr on STAR in zdc airspace.
show: 1998-06 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A wdb freighter lands at pen; FO; without benefit of a landing clearance. Crew was on tower frequency but did not chk in with lcl controller. Gnd controller advises crew of the transgression.
show: 1998-06 · Procedural: Landing Without Clearance · Initial Approach

text: A B737 was improperly dispatched with the airstair door inop and deferred per the MEL but not printed out on the flight release.
A B737 FLC overshot their reassigned alt when the PIC PF was distr by conversation with a flight attendant. Atc corrected alt overshot.
Instructor pilot landed gear up in a school trainer; mooney M20J; (MO2J) due to distr and forgetting to use the chklist.

Pilot of a piper PA12; tailwheel aircraft lost control of aircraft while making a turn off the runway striking a taxiway sign. Reporter stated that a gust of wind lifted up the tail resulting in a sharper turn than planned causing the horiz stabilizer to contact the sign.

A controller reports that an acr DH8 was released for takeoff on runway 29 as an acr BE02 was on a two mile final approach to runway 11. This is something that the controller says often happens because of the facility's policies and their agreements with other facilities.

An atct lcl controller reports that an acr E120 was clred for takeoff on runway 29 as a cpr HS25 was on final approach to runway 11. The aircraft came within one mi of each other. The controller complains about the policy that allows opposite directions operations without radio contact with the principle flcs.
Lr35 crew had total radio failure and loss of thrust in #2 engine. They declared an emer by squawking the appropriate xponder code and made an emer landing.
A B727 was dispatched with a required MEL special procedure to chk the crew oxygen bottle pressure prior to each departure not signed for in log.
Pilot of an atx C208; caravan; flight planned and was clred by ATC; to fly 3000 ft below the mea (minimum enrte alt). The pilot did not observe the correct mea alt on his worn IFR enrte chart.
Flc of a B737-200 forgot to contact tower at the om as instructed by ATC and landed without clearance.
Reporter claims lax approach allows jump aircraft to climb to 14000 ft where there are IFR operations and permits them to make parachute jumps into control airspace.
On board B767-200; pax became abusive during boarding and flight. Threatened crew after arrival in customs. Obtained copies of crew passports from airline personnel upon arrival at dest.
Flc of a british jetstream; BAE3100 (BA31); declared an emer and returned to land overwt due to loss of pwr in left engine caused by a bird strike just after takeoff in an initial climb.
Nmac btwn a beech A36; bonanza; in cruise flight at 7500 ft and a C310 in cruise flight at the same alt. Reporter in the A36 made a climbing turn to the right and the C310 turned to the left.

Right engine on a piper seneca; PA34-200 (pase); quit during touch and go causing the trainee pilot to lose control of the aircraft and go off the side of the runway through a grassy area btwn the runway and parallel taxiway. There were no injuries to the trainee and his instructor; and only minor damage to the right wing flap and runway sign in the grass.
show: 1998-06 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Takeoff

text: Nmac btwn a fokker F28 on a visual approach to a non tower airport just outside of the marker and a piper seneca making practice approaches approx 300 ft below on the same heading. The seneca pilots observed the F28 as it passed them overhead and the F28 observed the seneca to the rear of them. The seneca did not have the xponder turned on so did not show up on the F28's tcasii.
Flc of a DC9 took off with clearance due to a misunderstanding of tower controller's instructions to taxi into position and hold.
A canadair challenger 600 on descent at 13500 ft experienced a cracked copilot's windshield when entering a hvy rain shower. Gnd inspection revealed additional radome damage.
Flc of a B737 did not hold short of taxiway as instructed in taxi instructions resulting in GND controller intervening and directing reporter to a holding area clear of intended taxiway.

During GND holding due to dest weather; the captain of an MD80 summoned lcl police to have a pax removed from aircraft due to uncontrollable behavior. The captain had to leave aircraft to sign the appropriate complaint.

Flc of a B757-200 overshot assigned alt during SID climb due to momentarily losing aircraft pitch and thrust control due to sudden unexplained autothrottle increase in pwr. The captain was able to return to assigned alt after stopping the climb 800 ft above desired alt.
Captain of a gulfstream 1; turboprop; G159; overshot assigned alt due to severe turb. Subsequently caused aircraft to climb off assigned alt resulting in ATC approving a higher assigned alt.

An MU2 FLC has an nmac with a B727 flight on approach to runway 28 at msy. The MU2 crew had been given that traffic for runway 28 but actually looked at and regarded as traffic the B727 on approach to runway 19 at msy.

A thorp 18 tiger pilot is asked to contact bdl approach controller after landing at baf; ma. He was thought to have penetrated the class c at bdl while traversing the area at 4500 ft. He had a potential conflict with opposite direction traffic at that alt.

Pilot of an mo-20J describes his entry procedure into a non tower airport; T05; tx. He had not filed an IFR flight plan and attempted a VFR flight using a gps with 'tired' batteries. He was not happy with his performance.
An MD82 is hit in the radome by a tug after the pushback was completed. The tug moved forward after the tug driver left the vehicle to assist the other cgp with the towbar disconnect procedure.

A pvt pilot allows a student pilot to fly his aircraft while apching buf airport. The 'team' turns to the wrong heading while trying to fly a left downwind to runway 23. The aircraft is flown across runway 23 departure end when student pilot attempts a right downwind leg.
show: 1998-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Approach

text: On inspection of JT9D-20J and -7J engine buildup records it was discovered some 4TH stage low pressure turbine discs may have been installed and in svc with life cycles exceeded.
A C210 pilot lands and his gear folds on the runway. He had done a 360 degree on final for traffic spacing from the tower and had cycled the gear rapidly.

4 hrs into flight on board MD11 pax awoke and became physically abusive to pax seated next to him. Shortly after same pax punched another pax; FLC restrained him and diverted to alternate to deplane and release disruptive pax to auths.
A DC9-30 PIC declares an emer when the nose gear indicates an unsafe position. The inspection window for nose gear down verification was too dirty to chk the gear's position.

A DH8 PIC report on phl tower controller holding aircraft on runway side of the hold short line on runway 17 and simultaneously using that runway for takeoffs and landings. Reporter says it '...is not an isolated case.'

A dsnding B737-300 FLC experiences a potential conflict with a climbing DH6. The DH6 was on a visual separation climb from the B737 but; according to the PIC of the B737; he got too close for comfort.
An sma pvt pilot lands his aircraft in a field after the engine seizes. Prop damaged.

Dc9 crew was required to make a rapid descent when the aircraft cabin began to climb unctlably. The crew did not make the appropriate altimeter setting; at the transition alt; while making the descent; resulting in a leveloff 300 ft low.
A potential conflict existed btwn 2 B737's when the approach controller gives an erroneous clearance to acr x; thinking that this new clearance was going to provide separation.
An sma departure from hwd flies into oak's class c airspace without auth.
show: 1998-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Climb
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flight attendant injured when wdb aircraft encounters clear air turb in sgfa airspace.
L1011 unable to stay behind B737 landing on parallel runway at sfo.
Dc9 crew received a tcasii ta and then an RA. Controller had given descent clearance that crossed another aircraft's alt.
At cruise on board B727-200; cabin window failure causing divert to alternate for maintenance without further incident.
A DC9-31 performs an emer descent and diversion when they lose cabin pressure. Ztl controller gives off course vectors in aiding descent. 1 pax and 1 flight attendant treated by emt personnel.

Flc of a B767 missed turning on the aircraft hyd sys prior to pushback and subsequent starting of engines. The aircraft started rolling with parking brake set until the hyd sys was turned on and brake pressure established.
show: 1998-06 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Controller allowed aircraft to land with another aircraft on runway at pvd airport.

Fo of an acr mlg lost control of the aircraft and struck the right wing landing light on the runway during landing. At the time of the mishap; there were strong gusty xwinds; and shear conditions. Postflt inspection revealed only damage to the landing light which was replaced.
Acr crew misses heading change on STAR rte in sea airspace.
show: 1998-06 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: Student pilot lands short; hits runway light at cmh.

Nmac btwn an ATR72 cruising at 14000 ft MSL and a piper malibu; PA46 passing 500 ft below. Reporter in the ATR72 clbed in response to a tcasii RA even though traffic was sighted. Artcc radar controller issued a ta prior to the tcasii RA.

Flc of a B757 overshot assigned departure alt soon after takeoff on a SID departure due to clearance change and the autothrottles still on takeoff setting and not reduced to climb pwr. Therefore; it took more time to level off aircraft.

B737-400 cabin door warning light illuminated during takeoff roll causing the captain to take over control of the aircraft from the FO and abort the takeoff at an airspd of more than 110 kts; which is well below decision speed of 147 kts. The aircraft was subsequently returned to the gate due to a lengthy brake cool down period.
Mlg aircraft on vector and climbing when vector heading took aircraft toward build up of clouds. Reporter captain; trying to top clouds; flew 500 ft above assigned alt.
Pilot of a C152 started takeoff roll when a cessna citation was still on the runway after landing at an unctled airport.

Commercial pilot of a hot air balloon drifted into class b airspace due to unexpected strong winds without time for the pilot to notify approach radar controller of his problem. The balloon landed behind a bluff on a construction driveway which blocked the wind for landing.
show: 1998-06 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Landing
cat: Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit

text: Flc of a saab SF340 (SF34L); forgot to call tower for landing clearance and realized it after landing and calling GND control for taxi to parking.

Captain of a beech airliner 1900 (BE02); misinterpreted takeoff clearance and taxied to the other parallel runway for takeoff instead of the one he was holding short. The tower controller observing this sent another aircraft around and reclred the captain for the other parallel runway to which he was heading.
An mlg on a test flight in cruise at FL350 declared an emer and diverted due to an APU fire warning caused by an improperly installed APU exhaust tailpipe.

text: Tracon departure controller has B757 on gar and plans vector to n and e of airport. Not seeing any aircraft in proposed departure list; he initiates vector n. A non arts displayed B737 reports on frequency at same alt of climbing B757; passing behind gar B757 traffic and separation is lost.
Pilot of a thrush S2R agricultural plane runs out of gas on return from spray op. Off airport landing.
An acr A300 returns and lands at sju after an indication of an engine fire. Engine was shut down. A pax observed a tailpipe fire which sponsored an aircraft evac with CFR in attendance.
An A300 has its right engine fail during departure from lhr.
B727 crew had indications of a pneumatic sys leak in a pressurized area. #2 engine oil temp also rose to red line. Crew shut down #2 engine and made an emer landing.
An MD82 landing at bur blows a #3 tire on rollout. Pic stops aircraft on taxiway for evaluation.

Acr FK10 FLC challenges approach controller's clearance for visual approach to runway when observing conflicting traffic. Controller reclrs FK10 for visual approach to other runway. Later investigation determines FK10 acknowledged approach clearance to wrong runway and no once caught incorrect readback.

Tracon controller accepts non-specific coord and issues control instructions for mil fgt arrival; thinking other controller is coordinating for proposed arrival strip posted for his sector. Controller initiates coord to adjoining sector for wrong mil fgt. Other controller hands off another mil fgt on heading and alt specified. Incorrect coord with other control sectors involves operror with 2 acr aircraft in a third; adjoining sector.
Pilot of turbo arrow flies into a restr area which is hot. It was not hot when he received his first briefing but become hot prior to his entry.

text: Instructor with inst student has loss of pwr on left engine. Emer declared engine feathered. Successful landing made.
An acr FO report regarding his takeoff data computations at anc; ak. Runway 14 did not allow a max takeoff wt for his aircraft with a 10 kt headwind. Runway 24L; 800 ft shorter with a xwind; did.
Pilot of experimental seaplane buccaneer makes a takeoff and barely clbs above trees.
Pilot of a kitfox experimental aircraft flew into class c airspace with no xponder.
show: 1998-07 · Other Airspace Violation Entry or Exit · Cruise

text: Artcc controller reacts to conflict alert activation when dsnding acr overshot assigned alt of FL180 and conflicts with DH8 at 17000 ft.
At cruise; onboard B757; pax became ill and flight attendant assisted pax. Pax recovered before landing.
Onboard MD80S; pax was boarded intoxicated and was disruptive the entire flight. Flc had auths meet aircraft at dest.
A climbing B727 was stopped in its climb out of cos and leveled at the same alt as a XING VFR PA28. Tcasii solved the problem of the traffic conflict when the controller couldn't. Possible nmac.
At pushback onboard MD80; pax became ill and PIC returned to gate for medical assistance.
A cl65rj on approach to cvg flies through the loc course when the auto-capture mode of the autoplt defaults to the heading mode.
show: 1998-07 · Deviation - Track / Heading All Types · Initial Approach

text: On descent onboard DC10-10; aircraft hit wake turb causing cabin attendants to be injured. Flight landed without incident.

Dc9 crew had FOD to both engines during landing roll and taxi in at msp runway 30R. Severity of damage required an engine change and repair to one engine; and engine change and overhaul on the other. Fod is reported to be 'black tar type substance' from the runway.

An SF340 FLC returns to dfw and makes a zero flap landing when they assume that they have a loss of hyd pressure. Previous to the diversion; they had experienced a soda can spill on their center electronic panel; which shorted out some circuits. The hyd pressure gauge for the main accumulator had fallen to zero.

Acr BE02 FLC aware of climbing BE90 traffic; but no visual contact. Be90 has BE02 in sight and commences VFR climb. Be02 tcasii RA climb maneuver initiated when BE90 is already above the BE02. Be02 clbs through BE90 alt; and receives a tcasii RA descent command; but is arrested by PIC. Atc tried to stop climb action; but BE02 PIC advises they will follow RA command.
show: 1998-07 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Cruise

text: A B757-200 FLC notes a loss of airspd at FL410. The left engine parameters indicated an inflt spool down. Pic asks for lower alt from ATC and after 9 minutes the 'engine comes to life.' during event airline maintenance was contacted and had no solutions for the crew. Later information indicated that maintenance control had ref to a svc bulletin issued for this same aircraft within the past 2 wks.

Tower lcl controller instructs C210 pilot to follow traffic; calling base and final. Pilot perceives traffic on runway will not clear in time and executes gar. Pilot and controllers exchange comments on frequency when pilot directed to turn downwind; base and final at controller's call. Aircraft oil overheat occurs and pilot declares emer. Pilot incensed by perceived controller intrusion of 'in- cockpit' traffic sequencing.
An A320 FLC fails to make their XING restr when the low time in type captain places incorrect data in the mcdu.
Pilot would like atis to be on a VOR that is being used for his approach or arrival.

Artcc controller evidently assigned FL240 to LR24 FLC and does not hear incorrect readback of FL340. Controller takes action when conflict alert is activated; but is unable to maintain legal separation. Pilot asked to call facility.
An acr light overshot its alt in climb. Reporter cites hearback problem with N90 controller.
Acr landed at airport after tower was closed; when pilot started taxi to terminal; discovered taxiway route ahead was barricaded.
An sma pilot performs an off airport precautionary landing when he suspects that all is not well in the fuel quantity dept. Lands in a pasture 5 mi from his diversionary airport.
A DC9 FLC fails to follow the arrival procedure over omn; FL. In their 'straying' from the desired course they create a potential conflict with another aircraft.
A PIC's report on having a later notification that there were 2 armed govt agents onboard. The cabin attendant showed the captain her copies of the notice form during clbout from dfw.
During an episode with weak radios; zid controller gave B737 an immediate descent to FL280 from FL290. Pilot received tcasii ta 900 ft above and 8 mi horiz.

A B737 crew declares an emer for a low fly-by when they are unable to change the left gear indication light bulb. Maintenance had informed them that it was near to impossible to perform that task while inflt which they had discovered before the phone patch.

A low time balloon pilot injures one of his pax when he drags his basket through some trees and makes a hard landing in a soybean field. Pilot reported encountering unforecast winds and convective activity.
show: 1998-07 · Ground: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Parked

text: Pa60 pilot initiates evasive turn to avoid tower issued traffic; PA28; opposite direction; on short final. Apparently on IFR approach; zma did not coordinate PA28 with tower; having already released an IFR departure opposite direction to aircraft on approach.
A B767-200ER was dispatched after having an extended range overwater chk performed by unqualified mechs.
A B767-300 was dispatched with the aux pwr unit oil cap not installed and secured.
Nmac. Flc of an mlg dsnded from assigned alt in response to a tcasii RA during a STAR arrival. The other unknown aircraft came within 300 ft of the reporter's aircraft.

Flc of a super MD80 did not accept ARTCC radar controller heading due to severe tstm weather build-up; resulting in ATC declaring an emer for them and assigning a xponder code of 7700 due to hvy traffic in the area. The crew believed that there was insufficient coord btwn ATC departure and center controllers.
A fokker 100 was dispatched with an unapproved interim repair to the aircraft overwing emer exit lights.
At cruise onboard MD80S; pax became ill and FLC made emer landing at alternate. Paramedics meet aircraft. Flight proceeded without further incident.

Artcc controller relieves a sector at zmp and instructs a king air in adjoining airspace to contact the sector. The king air does not acknowledge the frequency change and controller is distracted and forgets to notify the sector.

text: C210 makes forced landing after losing engine pwr in zob airspace.

Captain; flying; overshot GS alt during a visual approach due to the lack of autoplt alt capture. He noticed his mistake and clbed back as approach controller also questioned his alt. The FO had set in the missed approach alt too early; causing the autoplt capture to be ineffective.

Pvt pilot of a piper cherokee lance; PA32; had the landing gear collapse during landing; caused by loss of electrical pwr due to alternator belt missing. The reporter was aware of the missing belt prior to the last 2 flights with the intention of flying the aircraft to his maintenance shop. However; he did not perform the landing gear down chk since he had left it down for the trip.

Instructor trainee for additional instructor inst and multi-engine ratings; took off with the landing gear switch in the up position; resulting in nose gear retraction during rotation; which caused the aircraft to bounce into the air. Then; the main gear retracted upon lift-off. The PIC instructor took control of the aircraft. The right engine stopped during the bounce into the air. The aircraft pancaked onto the runway; skidded to the left side; and came to a stop.

text: Captain of a saab 340B; SF34L; undershot XING alt during arrival descent; resulting in ARTCC radar controller intervention to remind him of the fix 1 mi ahead.
At cruise onboard B757; child gets coin lodged in his throat; cabin attendants treated and paramedics met aircraft at dest.
A jetstream 4100 in cruise at 17000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to pax cabin air contamination.
Faa flight chk pilot concerned when he receives information that scheduled air traffic facility inspections may result in a pltdev.
Flc of citation 525 on a test flight has low level fuel annunciators flicker. Heading back to the airport; the right engine flames out; then the left. Off airport landing is made on a hwy.
B737 captain; unaware of position; turned past his outbound heading and was about 12 mi off track.

text: A jetstream 4100 in cruise at 6000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to uncommanded rudder inputs from the yaw damper sys.

text: Reporter claims arrivals from center were coming in high and fast; not in accordance with the loa; causing a loss of separation btwn a departure and an arrival.
Zny controller states parachute jumping in the vicinity of ptw is conflicting with departures and enrte traffic. Controller claims there are no effective procedures in place to control the jumpers.

Captain of a canadair regional jet; CL65; slowed from assigned speed during approach; since it appeared that they would overtake a B727 on final ahead of them as indicated on tcasii and visual sighting. However; the final controller questioned them as to why they were not at assigned speed. Causing them to believe that they were not complying with their clearance.
A B737-300 was dispatched with a reported flight control problem not investigated by maintenance.
B737 crew had flaps fail to extend after departure from blocks.
Flc of a B737-400 responded to a clearance for another aircraft resulting in ATC intervening and stopping their descent.

text: Fo of a super MD80 misread a STAR arrival DME fix resulting in undershooting the XING alt fix by 4 mi.

Maui tower controller is concerned about an aircraft on a maui position symbol observed dsnding overhead maui then disappears.
Flc of a B737-300 clbed above assigned alt due to the autoplt alt hold mode disconnecting due to higher than cruise pwr setting.
