text: Flc of B727 on landing has anti-skid braking cycling on rollout. The runway has excessive rubber buildup along entire length of runway causing deterioration of braking.

Captain of a fokker 100; FK10; mistakenly taxied on a wt restr taxiway resulting in tower GND control intervening to warn reporter about the restr. Reporter immediately used a tie-in to go to a parallel unrestr taxiway.

Preparing for descent to iad; FLC on B737 receives clearance for descent from FL230 to 11000 ft. During descent the crew receives 2 tcasii RA's and saw both aircraft; a B737 and a jetstream. No evasive action was necessary.

Pvt pilot of a C152 discovered that he had flown several flights with an expired 3RD class medical certificate since his last medical examination was prior to september 1996 and he was less than 40 yrs of age.

During spin practice; the pilot of a C150 came within 600 ft of a mil KC135 tanker upon recovering from a spin. The mil tanker was observed 1000 ft away at the same alt when both aircraft took evasive action.

Flc of a B727 overshot XING alt on descent due to the distr of concentration on the alt restr for the subsequent fix. Approach controller did not comment on the lack of not meeting the alt restr at the first fix.
show: 1998-07 · Altitude: Crossing Restriction Not Met · Descent

text: A B737-200 in climb at FL250 experienced an uncommanded instantaneous yaw and 20 degree bank to the right caused by a failed yaw damper computer.

Pvt pilot training for his commercial certificate rating; in a piper arrow; PA28R-200; and accompanied by a flight instructor; made a hard landing causing damage to the wing spar where the right landing gear is attached. Area had been damaged previously.

Glider instructor; accompanied by a student pilot; of a SGS2-33A lost pitch control of the glider after lift-off during a GND auto tow resulting in a hard landing; but no damage to the glider. However the student pilot received neck injuries and the reporter a sore neck and shoulder.
show: 1998-07 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Takeoff

text: Controller at zid was handling a CL65 at FL220 and a CL65 possibly climbing to FL220 and may have misjudged spacing btwn the 2 aircraft.

Pvt pilot of a flight in a C182 departed an unctled airport on an IFR flight experienced difficulty contacting center departure control due to not squawking the xponder code given in his clearance prior to takeoff.

Pvt pilot of a piper PA28-161 lost control of the aircraft during takeoff roll and aborted; going off the side of the runway. The aircraft ran over a PAPI light and discovered after the aircraft stopped that the pax had her feet on the left rudder pedal and brake.

text: A B737-200 was dispatched with an incorrect log item entered in error.

text: Pvt pilot of a piper PA12; tailwheel aircraft lost control of the aircraft during landing in a gusty xwind condition resulting going off the side of the runway through a fence into a hay field where it came to rest on its nose. The pilot; the sole occupant; was not injured. The aircraft received damage to the prop; nose cowling; wing strut; left landing gear; wingtip and a fence post.
show: 1998-07 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Captain of an acr mlg was down to minimum fuel after waiting for an approach due to severe tstm weather microburst; so advised ATC that he could not take any more delays. Atc suggested that he declare an emer in order to be given priority handling. He did and landed safely.

Pilot of an smt twin overflew an airworthiness directive during a scheduled trip due to weather avoidance. Pilot did not know that there was no over limit time due to unforeseen delays because of weather.

Nmac btwn a saab SF340 on an ILS approach and a heli XING underneath the loc causing the SF34 tcasii alert to warn of traffic. The FO flying the SF34 stopped descent and leveled off until the tcasii showed clear of traffic. Reporter believes that there could have been a collision if their aircraft did not have tcasii to warn them.
Flc of a DC9 turned and dsnded in response to a tcasii RA during a STAR arrival descent. Approach radar controller advised that the traffic just 'popped up' on their screen.
Pilot of c172rg has close prox to tower located off the end of runway 17 at etn airport. Tower is not lighted; not mentioned in the airport facility directory and not shown on charts.

B767. Fo and relief pilot received an alt clearance from gander oceanic clearance delivery. Based on that they started a climb to the clred alt. When they contacted gander center they were informed that they were not legal to climb based on that clearance.
show: 1998-07 · Altitude: Excursion From Assigned Altitude · Climb

text: An atx pilot (PA31 piper navajo) reports that the use of ILS frequency 108 pt 9 created a loss of his garmin 195 gps signal. This was chked several times for repeats of the initial event.
Flc believes they may have departed pit without receiving an IFR clearance.
Dtw and yip arpts are approx 8 mi apart. Reporter claims slow climbing aircraft from dtw can easily conflict with traffic at yip.
Hot air balloon pilot landed in IMC conditions; caused by fog.
Captain of a B737-300 overshot assigned alt during descent for approach due distr from an earlier tcasii alert. Controller intervened and issued clearance.
Pilot of a C172 loses control of the aircraft during landing and porpoises several times coming down hard on the nosewheel causing the tire to blow out.
show: 1998-07 · Inflight: Loss Of Aircraft Control · Landing

text: A B727 landing gear light sys was repaired with a landing gear accessory unit and tested per the maintenance manual. The procedure did not require testing the associated sys using outputs from the unit.

An mlg commercial fixed wing aircraft on takeoff roll noted the failure of the airspd; altimeter and vert speed indicators caused by the static and pitot pressure lines not connected to the #2 air data computer.

Nmac btwn 2 agriculture applicator aircraft at 475 ft above an agriculture field in which 1 aircraft (reporter) had just clbed up from a field he was spraying and another coming toward him in level flight. Reporter turned to avoid the other aircraft.

Pilot of a C210 made an off airport forced landing after the engine quit. He was low under an ovcst when the engine started sputtering so he switched to the other fuel tank with more fuel and the engine quit. He landed in a field striking a cow with the right main landing gear shearing it off. There was no other structural damage to the aircraft.
At cruise onboard MD80S; pax became ill. Flc diverted to alternate for medical attention for pax. Flight continued on without incident to dest.

Flc of a B727 diverted after having the lower body overheat warning light come on and high rising oil temp of the #2 engine located in the AFT fuselage tail. The engine was shut down and emer declared. Successful landing made and the pax deplaned in the normal manner.
Dc9 crew took off with the equip and electronic compartment door not locked closed. The door warning switch failed in the closed position.
B737 crew lost control of cabin pressurization during climb.
Instructor with student pilot aboard doing practice touch and go landings has problem stabilizing the aircraft and goes onto runway overrun; by about 10-12 ft. No damage to aircraft.
show: 1998-07 · Other Runway Or Taxiway Excursion · Landing

text: Tower instructed DC9 at lga airport to gar due to traffic on the runway. During the gar; the DC9 crew were not immediately able to communicate with tower for a heading and alt. Tower finally instructed DC9 to maintain 1000 ft. At the same time the crew received a tcasii RA to descend. At 1000 ft; the crew observed a commuter fly overhead at about 1500 ft. The captain said the tcasii worked fine but the volume is not loud enough.
Pilot of air taxi sma aircraft lands at non tower airport with construction under way. He comes within 50 ft of construction workers adjacent to the runway.
A DC9-30 in cruise at flight level diverted due to a left engine oil strainer clog light illuminated caused by a failed oil strainer clog switch.
Pic of DO328; unsure of taxi instructions; taxies across active runway without clearance. Fo; new hire; was uncertain of runway XING clearance; but captain felt clred to cross.
Pilot flies over 34 hrs in 7 days in mry airspace.
A B757-200 shut down #1 engine inflt due to loss of oil quantity and pressure caused by a scavenge oil line connector not secured.
A DHC6-300 in climb at 7000 ft on engine test flight diverted due to #1 engine failure caused by no oil in the pwr section.

On receiving a clearance for an ILS approach to sdf airport; the pilot; flying a mooney aircraft; began his descent from the approach alt before he had reached the glide path intercept point. The pilot claims he was following the GS indicator but was alerted by the controller when he dsnded before the intercept point.
Flc of cpr ltt on initial climb discovers nose gear will not retract. During vectors for return they misinterp climb clearance and exceed assigned alt by 600 ft.

Pilot in a BE36 taxied out for departure at olu; an unctled airport. Using CTAF procedures; the pilot announced his departure and did not hear any other calls. At lift-off the pilot noticed an aircraft landing on the opposite end. He made an immediate right turn to avoid a collision. The pilot then noticed he was on the incorrect airport frequency.
Instructor pilot with student has engine fire after priming engine and attempting a start.
Be90; a pressurized twin engine turboprop; had an explosive decompression when the pax door failed and came off the aircraft.
Pa28 pilot deviates from SID departing bos.

Acr crew responds to tcasii RA and reports nmac in phl airspace.
Pilot of a C150 on approach and landing at a non tower airport unicom has close prox to aircraft ready to depart opposite direction runway.
Flc on B727 landing at kingston; jamaica; enters a holding pattern at 4000 ft. After being clred for the VOR DME approach; a 360 degree turn was required on final to lose alt.
B737 crew shuts down engine and continues to dest in zdc airspace.
Acr aircraft experienced bomb threat and subsequent evac.
Pvt pilot departs bmg with magnetic compass inop.
Single engine aircraft lands short of runway at 6b6.

During cruise onboard MD80S; pax became ill and FLC diverted to alternate for medical assistance.
G4 crew exceeds 200 kts below msp class b airspace.
A fokker 100 was dispatched after maintenance with the left stub wing upper and lower access panels not secured incurring damage to the panels.
During climb acr A300-600 experienced a #1 engine fire. Flc returned to land and evaced aircraft with only 3 exits due to a door that would not fully open.
Pa12 pilot nosed over while doing xwind touch and go landings.

B737 crew had flight guidance change from alt hold to control wheel steering pitch. This resulted in a 1000 ft alt excursion.

text: A B24 flies in prox of a B747 apching msp for publicity purposes. The PIC of the B747 was on his last flight and the airline; his son and his friends coordinated with ATC for this unrehearsed formation flight.
An MD88 was dispatched with an incorrect repair for a report of excessive nose gear vibration.
At the mht airport; FLC received taxi instructions for a departure on runway 24. Because of a miscom with the FO; the captain taxied across runway 24 believing their departure runway was runway 17.

Artcc radar developmental controller takes pointout on climbing; cross traffic; but does not recognize potential conflict with his own traffic. Conflict alert activates. Two controller sectors attempt to regain separation; but are unable.
E120. Captain's outer pane windshield shattered.
Md80. Cabin attendant informed the crew they had some smoke in the AFT cabin. Smoke set off both alarms in the rear toilets.
Md80s FLC; last of three aircraft clred to cross runway; hears tower clear aircraft for takeoff; stops short of runway and advises tower. Tower's response indicates communication breakdown.

An A300 left engine hits the jetway at the gate in mia. There had been a marshaller and wing walkers attending the parking op with an agent on the jetway.
Single engine aircraft declares emer and lands at sdm after pwr loss.
An MO20 pilot takes his aircraft for a test flight after having the gear warning horn sounding off while taxiing on the ramp.

A return land is mandated by the report from the cabin attendant that a tail strike on takeoff occurred at fra.

Flc on ATR72 enrte to mia level at 6000 ft received tcasii RA to descend. Passing through 5700 ft; pbi approach issued a traffic alert and FLC saw cargo B727 pass 300-400 ft overhead. Reporter believes if cargo aircraft were required to have tcasii; evasive action would not be as severe.
An instructor pilot report on not complying with the alt heading rule while flying w from cll to sat. The aircraft was at 5500 ft and under ARTCC radar observation.

An FK28 has to abort his takeoff when the captain notes a cessna aircraft landing opposite direction on runway 2 at fca; mt.
While parked at gate; onboard B727-200; pax medical emer occurred. Paramedics used AFT stairs to access aircraft and remove pax.

A C182 pvt pilot suffers a prop strike on landing. Reporter cites a possible low level wind shear that caused some bounces.

Dc9 crew had leading edge slat fail to extend.

Acr CL65 PIC takes evasive action due to tcasii RA to avoid conflicting traffic at same alt. Pic does not visually see traffic due to weather.

Pilot of C182 on final approach at a non tower airport sights an aircraft opposite direction; same alt; about one fourth mi to his left. A gar is executed.
Pilot of C402 has nmac with DC9 whose tcasii activates.

Acr MD80S FLC exercise pilot prerogative and executes tcasii RA maneuver for control VFR cessna traffic under control of tracon. Traffic issued.

Artcc radar controller; providing ojt instruction; misidents F14 mil aircraft and hdofs mil aircraft to other controller. Mil aircraft comes in conflict with climbing MD80 on other controller's frequency.

Tracon approach controller perceives insufficient coord effected btwn tracon; skydiving op and ARTCC when he apparently observes nmac with acr jet and parachute op.

Flc of a B767 found that they were off frequency for 2 minutes during the time they would receive descent clearance on start of STAR arrival. Receiving controller initiates actions to separate aircraft when oedp activates; but actions are not sufficient to maintain separation.
Artcc radar controller dsnds one aircraft through the alt of another holding aircraft. Controller expected oedp would have alerted him to pending loss of separation.
Be76 pilot; distracted by fatigue; begins inadvertent descent while still assigned radar vectors with alt assignment. Pilot returns to assigned alt when alerted by mil controller.
Artcc radar controller reassigns dsnding alt for mil aircraft and clbs acr to same alt. Controller does not recognize error until separation was lost.
While parked at the gate; onboard MD80S; 2 pax boarded intoxicated and were removed from aircraft by lcl auths. Flight departed without further incident.
A DC9-32 inflt returned to the field due to loss of throttle control on #2 engine; engine shutdown. Found #2 engine pwr lever bolt missing.
Pilot of an atx smt sel turboprop discovered that he had not noticed that the required 30 day VOR chk had been exceeded.

Line chk captain of an acr mdt turboprop received approval from a medical examiner after cardiac angioplasty procedure for chk airman line duty from jump seat only. He is later told he is in violation of FAR 121 pt 411 (b)(5).

Pilot of a piper PA28-235 made off airport forced landing just after lift-off due to the engine quitting because of fuel starvation. The reporter did not have the fuel selector on a main tank with fuel since he went by the appropriate tank when adjusting the fuel selector during preflt.
A B737-200 was dispatched and returned to the field with excessive forward entrance door leakage caused by an incorrectly installed door snubber.
Mdt crew evaced aircraft pax at gate when they became aware of a fuel spill.

Captain of a DC10 found the APU running when he arrived at the aircraft for preflt and subsequently noted that there was an aircraft logbook entry regarding the APU being inop. However; the instructions that accompanied the write-up highlighted the APU problem as shutting down when starting the aircraft engines so GND op for the cabin environmental equip may not apply.
Dc10 crew was told their aircraft caused jetblast damage to another aircraft as they departed the ramp at lax.
B727 crew had #3 engine fail due to inadvertent selection of fuel cutoff.

Flc of a B727 forgot to write landing gear discrepancy in the aircraft logbook. Problem was caused by the lack of indication of a safe left main gear down and locked; discovered during final approach.
G4 crew executed a missed approach after being cut out of the pattern at an unctled airport.

Flc of a fokker 100; (FK10); became confused as to the actual clearance intended by the ARTCC radar controller when he asked them to turn 10 degrees off course when climbing to a higher alt. They thought that they had to wait for climb clearance. Controller seemed stressed with the traffic load.
Captain of an acr mlg declare an emer after the left engine quit during descent. Successful landing was made at their dest.

Flc of an acr saab 340; (SF34L); went around after encountering windshear on final which produced a severe xwind. They were directed to another runway which had a 90 degree xwind but not as severe. During turning to final for another runway after gar; the aircraft steep bank caused descent and terrain warning from the GPWS.
Hvt crew executed a missed approach.
Pvt pilot of an sel sma high wing struck a parked tie down aeronca champ during parking causing minor damage to both aircraft when the wingtip scraped the wingtip of the parked aeronca.

Flc of a cpr cessna citation iii C650 overshot alt during climb due clearance interp. Captain read back high alt with no ATC contradiction. However; ARTCC radar controller stopped their climb early and sent them back down. Crew thought that they heard it correctly and set the alt alerter accordingly.
Flc of a B737-200 return land after bird strike during takeoff initial climb. Engine damaged; caused plane change.

Tracon controller extends himself to resolve dual paradrop activity when none is required. Controller sites two instances during an op shift when he perceived he needed to intervene to resolve situations.

Captain of a B767 undershot descent fix due to short notice of fix and controller changes. In addition; since the vortac on which the fix was predicated was behind the aircraft; and they had such a short time to make the fix for the alt loss required; it made it very difficult to ident and make the fix. The captain complained that the fix should be made up on a STAR.

At gate; onboard MD80S; cabin attendant noticed fumes in cabin. Flc was unable to determine cause. At dest it was determined that the wrong cabin cleaning agent was used at departure. Aircraft was taken ots.

Acr B727 FLC PIC encounters adverse weather and attempts coord with ATC; but is unable due to poor communication with HF frequencies. Pic declares emer; exercises PIC auth to deviate from weather. Pic notified zny and reports back on course after dev.
Atx pilot of a piper chieftan PA31 forgot to put the gear down during landing causing minor damage to the aircraft and no injuries to the pax or himself.

Fo of an acr DH8 return land; and an emer declared after high engine oil temp caused an inflt engine shutdown of the #1 engine; when he did not have at least 100 hrs as sic in type of aircraft per company flight operations manual.

Captain of an acr light deviated around weather buildups while on an oceanic flight on his own command auth after waiting 15 minutes; and making 3 radio requests without success in obtaining an answer. After intercepting assigned course he inquired again; and again none had been received. After several yrs of flying the oceanic rtes; the captain believes that this is an inadequate control sys for the latest technology available.

Tower advised him after the fact that he should have faced the tower and shown a landing light in notifying the tower of his lost communication condition.

Nmac btwn a gov piper PA31 on a downwind leg in the traffic pattern and a beech bonanza in the opposite direction 200 ft above making a right turn. The reporter pushed forward to descend after observing the bonanza.
Airport operations closes runway and notifies the clt tower. Controller puts information on atis. Controller clrs IFR aircraft to taxi to the closed runway and then clrs the aircraft for takeoff.
Md80 crew had a 3000 lb wt discrepancy on various wt manifests.
B727 crew did not make a SID XING restr. They also had a leading edge flap that did not retract.
B747-400 captain attempted to descend using aircraft automation. When reprogrammed to comply with a new clearance; descent was delayed excessively.

Pilot of light twin engine aircraft following a westwind at sjt misunderstood controller instructions to gar. When the westwind landed it was necessary for the pilot to turn around at the end of the runway and back taxi. The controller instructed the twin engine aircraft to; 'gar;' but adding to the instruction; 'right side.' the pilot landed and taxied around the right side of the westwind on the runway.

Tracon approach controller frequency usurped by other gov; non coord interdiction action. Some control clearances delayed due to non coord activity. Controller asks 'spotter' to use another frequency.
Captain of an ltt charter flight does not comply with speed restr. When prompted by the FO he disregards the correction. Approach control finally asks his speed.

Flc of SF340 sights an unusual hold line which angles onto the taxiway; but does not cross the taxiway. There are hold lines further down the taxiway (closer to the beginning of the runway) so it is very confusing.
Pilot of a luscombe 8A tail dragger aircraft has fuel contamination and makes an emer landing in a farmer's field.
Artcc controller apparently did not notice aircraft turn to avoid weather and conflicted with an aircraft on a parallel rte.
Pilot of small aircraft contacted sacramento approach and was advised by the controller that he had violated the beale afb airspace.

text: 2 sma aircraft; one a low wing; one a high wing; have nmac.

A B757-200 was dispatched with the right nose gear wheel and tire assembly improperly installed. Spacer missing.
Fk10 crew questioned legality of dispatch with MEL'ed inop multiple engine ignition.
Atc lcl controller at lax allowed B747F to land on runway 24L with a B747F observed past the runway hold bars.
A dsnding aero commander atx flight overshot its alt by 1300 ft before ATC stops their descent.
Atct controller at lax states that the tracon is allowing B757 aircraft to pass traffic on the parallel runway causing a wake turb event.
Pilot of A36 at mke climbing on IFR departure encountered glider at 4500 ft and took evasive action. The departure controller did not observe the traffic on radar.
Acr B727 FLC became distracted with radio problems and miss turn for course radial change. Controller alerts FLC and FLC corrects flight rte. No apparent conflict noted.

text: Cga BE40 PIC took evasive action due to tcasii RA on initial departure climb out from traffic watch aircraft. Pic reports that controller stated that controller was at fault for not exchanging traffic prior to departure.

Pilot in PA28 landing at dlg; an unctled field; announces base turn for runway 19 on the radio. Turning final; pilot observes an acr holding on the ramp at the opposite end on runway 1. On touchdown; the pilot observes the acr taxi on the runway 1 and hears the acr pilot on the fss frequency inquiring about the cherokee on the runway.
Ramp chk inspector notes a leak from AFT lavatory. Maintenance finds no discrepancy. The FAA inspector is still pursuing the issue.

Controller at mke taxied an acr into position with an arriving aircraft on short final. The arrival; a beech king air; executed a missed approach and the controller clred the acr jet for takeoff with minimum separation behind the slower aircraft on the missed approach. Using tcasii; the acr pilot said the aircraft ahead did not clear the 2 mi ring.
At cruise onboard A300; pax became ill and was treated onboard by cabin attendants and nurses. Paramedics met aircraft at dest.

Cga BE40 PIC took evasive action; with ATC alt change assignment; due to conflicting traffic. Approach controller states that conflict initiated from ARTCC controller; assigning same; conflicting alt with other traffic. Pic advised difficult situation was presented to him; either turn in tstm activity or allow tcasii the ability to resolve the traffic conflict. This time PIC turned into weather.

Zdc radar controller reports a milfac spillout from W107; also involving zny. Facsfac vacapes attempted to handoff 2 A10's to zdc in zny airspace; already outside W107. Zdc refused the handoff of the A10's coming into conflict now with acr traffic handoff to zny. Vacapes turned and dsnded the A10's; evidently back into W107.

text: A300 crew had contaminated air in the AFT cabin inflt.
B757 crew was not properly notified of an armed pax. Armed prisoner escorts did not follow proper procedures while escorting prisoner.
Parked on ramp aboard A320; pax door slide inadvertently deployed; then deflated.

Flc of a B727 had APU fire warning at vr speed so rotated and clbed to safe alt where an emer was declared and a return overwt landing made at once. Emer GND personnel inspected aircraft for fire. Since no fire indication was found; FLC taxied to gate for maintenance. Crew complained of tower GND control not having a discrete frequency with which to communication with emer GND personnel.

Flc of an LR35 experienced an engine fuel controller failure soon after departure in class b airspace and requested clearance to return land. However; FO canceled IFR clearance to go VFR to home base causing controller difficulty in separating traffic and a potential collision with a king air going in the opposite direction.

Cga CL60 FLC; with maintenance person; become distracted with maintenance chk item and allow aircraft to descend below assigned alt. Controller alerts FLC to altdev. Aircraft returns to assigned alt until visual approach clearance is issued.
At cruise onboard B757; severe turb encountered causing pax and cabin attendant injuries in the AFT of the aircraft. Flc returned to mia for medical assistance.

C172 cfi did not observe student pilot had failed to fully activate xponder before departing airport. Controller alerted FLC to problem and student completely activated xponder. Training activity was conducted within the ord mode c veil.

Fo overshot climb departure alt due to distr of weather avoidance and the captain's failure to call out 100 ft to go since he was on company radio. The FO returned immediately after observing he was 400 ft above assigned.

Atct controller at nid had simultaneous broadcast and receive on VHF and uhf. When the controller issued a takeoff clearance to 2 F18's on uhf; a GA turbojet on a different runway and on VHF also acknowledge and made an unauthorized takeoff.
B727 crew was given an 'ok to continue' on a hyd brake problem.

Pilot of a wwii twin engine trainer; cessna T50; experienced a brake failure during landing roll resulting in losing control of the aircraft and going off the side of the runway. The aircraft hit a runway sign when it went off the runway causing only minor damage to the aircraft; sign not known.

text: Pilot instructor on an inst training flight failed to have trainee hold short of runway when taxiing off landing runway and XING the parallel runway due to misunderstanding of tower lcl controller instructions for leaving runway. After XING and stopping for GND control taxi instructions; controller gave them taxi to parking instructions and requested that they call the tower.

Flc of an embraer EMB145 (E145) operated aircraft under IFR flight plan rules when the MEL deferred #2 communication inop called for VFR only under FL180. Flc and dispatcher learned after a day of flying aircraft; including above FL180 required under IFR flight plan. Crew and dispatch believed that only IMC was not approved.

During a pre solo dual instruction flight; the student lands near the right side of the runway and the instructor tells him to correct back to ctrline which he did not do. He is told to go around and adds full pwr and the aircraft heads for the left side of the runway whereupon the instructor takes control of the aircraft. In the meantime the student reduced pwr and the aircraft crash lands off the left side of the runway damaging the right wingtip and aileron.

text: Pilot established communication with sbn approach 12 mi out and requested a clearance into sbn class c airspace. Controller issued the pilot a xponder code and 8 mi out informed him that he had not been clred into the airspace.

Md80 crew had 'tail compartment high temp' warning. After returning to departure station the captain disagreed about the suitability of the maintenance corrective action 'could not duplicate;' and refused the aircraft.
Flight crew of an acr mlg forgot to obtain a new maintenance release for a repaired taxi light and took off without it due to schedule pressure.
B737 crew departed without ensuring the aircraft crew portable breathing equip was aboard.

Nmac btwn an RV6 sma sel nearing traffic pattern for landing at an unctled airport and a sel biplane flying up along the right side of him; 30 ft away; without any prior arrangement or warning. It startled the reporter since he had not made any prior arrangement to do formation flight and the other aircraft was unknown to him.

A B747-400 flying in nttt airspace sends the wrong flight number in his data link. Nttt finds 2 aircraft with the same flight number and eliminates one of the flight plans for the duplicate flight number.
On the GND on a 5 hr delay onboard B727-200; cabin crew became exposed to chicken pox from a pax onboard.
A B737-300 found on arrival air conditioning GND svc door hanging open. Door closed by crew and taped closed by a ramp supvr with no log write-up.
On reaching the runway at mco for departure; FLC observed amber flashing lights and what they thought were red stop bar lights across the hold bar lines and refused to taxi across them.
A B737-300 was released for svc with the #2 air data computer static and pitot pressure lines not reconnected after an inertial ref unit replacement.
Turbine engine fire of a B757 during starting is put out by FLC after following engine starting fire procedures and shutting down the engine. The problem was caused by a sheared starter shaft.
Flc of an MD88 undershot XING descent alt.

Departure e controller received handoff from adjacent departure w controller in training stating tower had pointout on the IFR PA28 at 4000 ft. Acr aircraft departure climbing to 3000 ft and conflicted with PA28 that dsnded.

Pvt pilot of a c182rg requested clearance through class d airspace; for which he received clearance; to find out; as he was exiting the airspace; that he had actually been through another nearby class d airspace. He called back atct to inform them his actual location.

A taxiing acr mlg passes over the hold short line for runway 8 at abq. The aircraft was at taxiway A3 and the FO claims that there is an airport problem with the illusion of the taxiways at c; A1; A2 and A3 being simply exits from the ramp and not access taxiways to the runway. Says there should be warning signs regarding a possible runway incursion in this area.
After landing at iad DC9 FLC was instructed to hold short of hs-1 behind a B767. When the B767 continued to taxi; the crew in the DC9 followed.

Artcc radar controller gave them expeditious handling even though the captain would not declare an emer for fear of too many questions from FAA.

Controller working in tower with all position combined for lunch period; became very busy with traffic. A PA28 in the traffic pattern was clred for the option on runway 13. A short time later; the controller clrs an aircraft for takeoff on runway 8. The PA28 pilot on the option apparently saw the mistake and stopped on the runway short of runway 8.

When the FLC of a B737-400 advanced the throttles for takeoff; the takeoff horn sounded causing them to reject takeoff until they subsequently found and corrected the elevator trim setting into the green and reset the flap control back into its detent. The captain believes that flcs should use the before takeoff chklist when long delays occur prior to takeoff.
B757 acr dispatcher pointed out an inconsistency in MEL instructions on how he should handle an inop center tank boost pump.
Flc of MD80 on a directed gar experiences a sharp jolt and a bang. No other inst cues. They complete the gar and land.
Flight of B737; on which deadheading FLC were on as pax; pushed back earlier than planned resulting in their company rest period being shorted by 6 minutes.
Pilot of a bellanca viking 300 (BL26) failed to extend the landing gear and landed gear up causing damage to the prop; engine and lower fuselage skin.

Two aircraft attempted simultaneous landings on XING runways at 3SG; an unctled airport. The stearman pilot made normal traffic pattern to runway 23 favoring the wind direction. An instructor pilot and student landing on XING runway 09 aborted when they saw the stearman on approach at the intersection.

Fo of a fokker 100 (FK10) failed to intercept the assigned airway during departure climb due to not setting the FMC navigation mode. He recognized his mistake and corrected back with no apparent conflict observed or comment from ATC.

text: Flc of a B727 noticed the oil pressure dropping on the #3 engine during final approach. They performed the appropriate chklist and landed without further delay; including taxiing to gate. They did not declare an emer to the tower due to the lack of need for their assistance.

Instructor pilot of a C152 observed an ercoupe landing on the same runway on which he was back-taxiing; after landing at a non tower airport. He took control of the aircraft and went off the side into the weeds to allow room for the ercoupe to pass. In postflt discussion; the ercoupe pilot said that he believed that he had sufficient room to stop before reaching the C152 on the runway and did not want to attempt a gar on such a hot day.
Controller claims asr-9 radar at mci is displaying false targets almost daily.
On climb; a B757 FLC declared emer and diverted due to hyd sys failure. Aircraft landed without incident.

Pvt pilot filed; and flew; IFR flight plan when not inst rated. He was advised by his flight instructor after the round robin IFR flight that it was not legal. He believed that as long as he stayed VFR that he was legal to file and fly under an IFR flight plan.
Acr FLC leveling at FL280 received tcasii ta; then RA to descend. The crew immediately dsnded and passing through FL275; the tcasii indicated the traffic passed overhead at FL280.

Artcc supvr controller observes conflict at FL310 and dsnds one aircraft to FL280. During descent; controller recognizes conflict with aircraft at FL290 and stops dsnding traffic; climbing it back to FL310 and comes into conflict with beginning situation. Both aircraft react to tcasii.

Atx cargo pilot of a cessna caravan 208 (C208) dsnded to final approach alt on a transition to the final course when ARTCC radar controller assigned him to remain at his present alt until established. The reporter believed that since the transition rte was part of the published approach; he was established.

Pvt inst rated pilot of a sel sma lost all electrical pwr during vectors for an ILS approach and continued approach to landing without benefit of a clearance for the approach or landing. Pilot believed that he was still under IFR control and would continue in a timely manner with last intended clearance. Controller suggested that he circle the field until tower signal lights were obtained.

Pilot of a BE33C encounters deteriorating weather and sights an acr below him. He dsnds into clear weather then flies IFR flight plan.
At cruise on board B727-200 intoxicated pax refused to comply with FAR concerning interfering with the duties of a FLC member. Auths met aircraft at dest.
Bridge workers complained about agriculture spray operator of a turboprop agriculture aircraft coming right over them on a bridge adjacent to a field in which reporter was spraying.
B737 crew did not make a controller issued XING restr.
Fo of a B737-400 struck the tail during landing resulting in damage to the bottom of the fuselage forward of the tailskid.
Flc of a B757 overshot assigned alt during departure climb due to distr of workload and tasks associated with ATC clearance and frequency changes.
Pilot flying VFR into pao from the se cites several problems with the radar svc being provided by bay tracon.
Flc of a B727 found that the FO's directional gyro was inop during preflt and had to cancel flight.

Artcc radar controller concerned with activation of restr area. Traffic management coordinator advises controller activation time; but controller wants activation delayed. Supvr advises controller restr area is released in 30 seconds; and controller is displeased; but turns traffic away from restr area and objects.

Flc of a mil KC135E tanker on a training flight overshot assigned alt on a SID departure due to distr of weather avoidance. The reporter returned to assigned at once with no mention from ARTCC radar controller of the mistake.
A B737-400 was returned to svc with 1 incorrect log item deferral that involved 2 sys flight director and the autoplt.

Faa maintenance inspector on an enrte inspection alerts FLC to missing cockpit windshield trim and FLC advised that they will have it fixed upon return to home base. However; FLC did not write up in aircraft logbook and maintenance could not fix since trim was missing. Item had to be deferred as long as it was legally deferrable.
An unserviceable wheel and tire assembly removed from a bae RJ85 was found by an acr inspector to be partially inflated.
Instructor pilot of C172 in the traffic pattern has nmac with radio controlled model aircraft at 500-700 ft AGL.

Acr mdt captain; providing an ioc; replies to a similar but wrong call sign; and taxies onto the runway for takeoff. This action is recognized by the tower lcl controller when the aircraft is onto the runway; causing another aircraft to receive alternate landing instructions to another runway. Captain concerned that tower did not catch incorrect readback and with perceived; overworked controllers. Pilot suggests tower voice to written word computers for controllers.

Flc of a B727 aborted takeoff due to losing all pwr on the #1 engine. The aircraft became stranded after exiting on a high speed taxiway due to the brakes heating up during abort and locking up. Company maintenance came out and cooled brakes for release and towed aircraft to parking for deplaning the pax and maintenance.
Cl65 crew landed without getting landing clearance from the tower.

Pvt pilot of a piper PA28 lost all navigation and communication radios when flying near tstms. Subsequently; the pilot missed his dest due to the line of storms in front of his rte and was lost for sometime until recognizing landmarks. He then continued to the nearest VFR airport; which happened to be a mil base; flashed his landing light on final and landed.
Artcc radar controller does not observe auto handoff to other than intended ARTCC control sector; and xfers communication to intended ARTCC sector without an automated handoff.

Captain of a beech BE02 airliner shut down the right engine during taxi out for takeoff when the engine fire warning light came on. S80 captain report regarding the lahso operations at dfw with tailwind existing. When he spoke to the tower about the op; they stopped it.
Flc of S80 prepares for landing on runway 36; visual approach. When 4 pt 5 mi out they are switched to runway 33. An unstable approach results.

Flc of a B727 received a tcasii alert during final on ILS approach and then noticed a light turboprop twin making a banking turn away from them. As they continued the approach; they heard the other aircraft pilot advise the tower they had followed the wrong acr aircraft. No further conflict.

Flc of an acr mlg dsnded from assigned alt when ATC clred them to fly a transition. Approach radar controller intervened to advise that they had not been clred to a lower alt and the FLC informed them that they believed that they were automatically clred to the lower alt of the transition.

Flc of an MD80 rejected takeoff due to the left engine pressure ratio (EPR) indication was low. Subsequently found that the EPR gauge knob partial out and pushed it in and tested on run up. All chked ok and successful takeoff accomplished.
Captain of an ATR42 turned the wrong way during taxi to parking causing potential conflict with a jetstream 41 taxiing on the taxiway. Tower controller pointed out the reporter's mistake.

Flc of a dehavilland dash 8; DH8; took off without clearance. The atct lcl controller called their attention to the fact prior to turning them over to departure control.

Nmac btwn 2 hot air balloons touching at 2000 ft AGL when 1 balloon below and off to one side started ascending as the other had started dsnding. Both pilots started correcting back to stop the potential collision. There was no damage to the balloons or injuries to the occupants.

Flc of an MD88 responded to clearance by approach controller for another similar sounding same company call sign. Since the clearance was a clearance for a visual approach and contact tower; which the reporter did; the tower noticed the mistake and instructed reporter to do a right 360 degree turn and follow the originally clred aircraft for approach and landing.

Pilot in C560 inbound to pit experienced severe wake turb when the flight was turned in approx 4 mi behind a B737 and clred for an ILS approach. The reporter claims the pilot stated after he had landed that the aircraft had made a complete roll at 4000 ft.

Captain of mlg lost control during landing roll briefly due to asymmetrical thrust forces caused by only 1 engine reverser. He corrected back from the runway edge by disengaging the left reverser. Postflt inspection of aircraft revealed grass on the left main gear with no visual damage to the aircraft.

text: Flc of an unknown aircraft complained to tower because the reporter's sma heli was clred to cross in front of him; after another aircraft; on final. No evasive action taken in regard to the complaint; since the heli pilot was following tower instructions.
Flight of a B767-300ER encounters clear air turb. Flight attendants have carts out and they and the carts are thrown about. Injuries result.
A B757 loses a pneumatic access door in flight in ztl airspace.

Acr MD80 FLC observes tcasii traffic climbing from beneath in apparent conflict with them and notifies ARTCC radar controller. Climbing B757 also receives tcasii alert and stops climb. After conflict is resolved controller clbs B757 to higher alt. Pics of both aircraft state recommendations to correct incident.
B737 crew was forced to make an emer descent when both packs tripped off.

Pilot of an atx piper PA23-250 aztec; experienced the nosewheel collapsing during landing. Prior to approach; the reporter noticed a possible problem and believed that the nose gear was locked down. However; it was not; which left the aircraft stranded on the runway after collapsing.
B727 crew was forced to divert to their departure station when a door was not closed properly. Crew also complained about the anything goes attitude in the cabin on a charter flight.
Md80 crew executed a missed approach when the traffic the aircraft was to follow was too close.
Md80 crew dsnding into phx for visual approach receive a casual ta from the approach controller. Almost immediately after the traffic call; the crew have a tcasii RA and climb.

Captain of a beech 1900D (BE02) turned early after takeoff contrary to departure clearance. He became distr by a red equip warning light coming on and the memory chklist items to use in correcting the problem. After review of clearance with FO; and directing the FO to take appropriate chklist action; the captain started a correction back to assigned heading.

Md80 crew lost the right hyd sys.
A B757 crew was forced to make emer descent because of a loss of cabin pressurization.

Pilot of a cessna caravan 208 (C208) landed on the wrong parallel runway after making an ILS approach to minimums. He believes that his loc indicator was in error. He noticed his mistake during landing rollout.

Flc of a B737 were instructed by GND control to follow brasilia when taxiing to the gate after landing. However; they did not realize that the other aircraft would be coming from the quartering rear and therefore inadvertently went in front of the brasilia causing it to abruptly stop. After the rptrs learned that they had cut them off; they said sorry and taxied to gate.
Right main landing gear of an amphibious sma failed during landing due to corrosion. Aircraft stranded on non tower airport runway.

Flc of an mlg overshot alt prior to SID XING fix due controller phraseology of their clearance to a higher alt. However; the controller intervened in time for them to descend to meet the SID XING alt.

Flc of a B737-200 got a false GS during an ILS approach resulting in making a missed approach and then subsequent visual approach upon breaking out of the ovcst. Reporter stated that they were turned over late and clred for the approach by center causing them to intercept the GS high.
A climbing B757 on the loupe 9 departure from sjc overshot its assigned alt of 5000 ft.

During dual training flight in a beech A36; the trainee inadvertently lined up with the runway edge lighting for takeoff resulting in hitting 2 lights before aborting takeoff. The 2 runway lights and the aircraft prop were damaged.

Pax on an S80 flight became ill and the blood pressure cuff in the medical kit was inop. Illness caused flight to divert.

text: A B737-200 was dispatched with the radio altimeter deferred as inop per the MEL ('c' category item 10 day limit) with no mention of the aircraft on the GPWS and tcasii sys that are rendered inop ('a' category item 2 day limit). A time extension was granted by engineering for 1 day which is in conflict with the MEL requirement.

Captain of a B737-400 made a missed approach due to not being established on the ILS approach. Problem found to be caused by the radio receiver being tuned to the wrong ILS parallel runway. The second approach to the other runway proved this error.

A flight instructor with student pilot has navigation error in which he may have entered the class b airspace without clearance.

text: Departure climbing traffic a giv narrowly misses a dsnding C210 while departure lgb. The C210 was most likely on the VFR transition rte through the lax basin.

Pilot of a beech bonanza BE35 landed gear up causing damage to the prop; engine and lower fuselage skin. There were no injuries. Reporter believes that he mistook the gear switch for the flap switch and thought the gear warning horn was the sound of the cat ii inner marker beacon. In addition; he had the gear indicator light in the low dim setting.

King air pilot who made an inst approach to hwd then a divert to sql airport across the bay where weather had been reported as VFR in briefing. Pilot encountered marginal weather on the divert and contacted approach for vectors.

Flc of an acr mlg failed to descend in sufficient time to make alt XING restr due distr of reprogramming the FMC for the XING restr and at an increased airspd. There was no comment from center controller.
C172 pilots had nmac with parachutists who were jumping through clouds.

Pilot of an sel sma overshot assigned alt during clbout in class c airspace resulting in ATC intervention. He was advised in subsequent telephone conversation that a twin beech 18 had to take evasive action as a result of his overshoot.
The window from the pilot's side door fell off a C152 while in cruise at 1000 ft.

An acr PIC was removed from schedule during the preflt portion of a line chk. It was discovered by the chk pilot that the PIC's flight operations manual had not been updated with the last 6 revisions.
A BE20 super king air runs out of fuel on short final approach while diverting to U55; ut.
An acr light experiences a heading track position error when the captain dials in the wrong radial off of cie VOR.

text: Reporter claims the routing he is given into jfk is outside the class b airspace and is a traffic danger because of a high density of VFR traffic not required to have operating xponders. It also causes a high fuel burn because of low alts flown.
A pax and his friend are removed from a B757 at yyz when the pax mentions the word 'bomb' within an ill conceived joke.
B727 overshot clred alt on descent in atl airspace.
Aircraft boarding of a fokker 100 was started with 1 flight attendant not on board.
B727 crew was being parked by a GND marshaller. Aircraft right wingtip hit a light pole.
Nmac within the traffic pattern at a non tower airport btwn a C152 and a parachute jumping aircraft.
Freighter FO report on exceeding his 120 hrs in 30 days by one tenth of an hr (6 minutes). Crew member fearful of company disclosure to FAA about this 'violation.'
A C172 cfi aborts his takeoff when extreme shimmying is felt. A prop strike occurs after the nosewheel leaves the aircraft at about 25 kts.

text: A DC9-10 on short final has to execute a gar when encountering wake turb from the preceding landing B747 on runway 21R at dtw.
Zob radar controller becomes aware of aircraft conflict after observing conflict alert activation as a B737; naving to the wrong VOR; turns into a D328 at cruise.
A B737-200 aborts its takeoff just after entering runway when the dual bleed light is still on. The flight had been waiting for takeoff with 1 engine shut down. A hurry up deal.
An MD80 has problems with its pressurization sys and diverts to den. The flight attendants did not believe that this was a loss of cabin pressure.

A PA28 instructor and trainee obtain taxi clearance to pns runway 26 and taxi across runway 8 without clearance. Instructor states that published airport diagrams do not depict taxiways resulted from new airport construction. Instructor admits error.
An smt pilot penetrates the confines of R4807A while on a VFR flight plan direct to tph; nv.

A GND mech is blown off a ladder that was placed upon a DH8 40 ft behind an MD80 departing the gate in front of it.
Flc report on a tailstrike on landing in an SF340. A problem exists within the airline management policy procedure in loading procedures pax cargo.
An MD88 on takeoff at 50 ft AGL declared an emer and diverted due to #2 engine loss of pwr caused by turbine assembly component failure.

A dsnding falcon 2000 overshot its assigned alt when the crew had a clearance interp problem and a breakdown in the CRM as designed by their operations dept. Nmac occurred with commuter aircraft below.
A C172 pvt pilot experiences an nmac with an A1A wart hog flying an ir mil rte on IR719. Pilot was 'practicing a forced landing' at a non tower airport and encroached upon the ir rte.
A dsnding B727 does not make its alt XING restr.
A wdb freighter pushes back into taxiway v at mem without contacting the mem GND controller for clearance.
An acr mlg experiences a heading track position dev when the captain pushes the wrong button on the gps navigation sys. Atc gets them on track.
B737-300 encountered wake turb from a preceding A300 in zla airspace. The B737-300 evaluates it as a severe occurrence. No injuries or damage occurred.
A C310 gear collapses on landing. All gear signals were 'green' on the approach.
A C182 lands without clearance on the wrong runway at bed; ma. Pilot had incorrect frequency on radio and had not addressed the tower with a 'bedford' preceding the 'tower.'
An acr mlg freighter overshot its assigned alt of FL290 by 400 ft.
Be76 instructor and trainee. Student actuated gear switch rather than the flaps switch; when doing touch-and-go landings. The nose gear retracted on the GND as a result.

Single engine aircraft loses all electrical pwr and communication in msp airspace.
Acr crew allows unauthorized jump seat rider at mia.
Sf340 crew taxiing in to gate under guidance of 2 marshallers hit corner of building with the right wingtip.
Md80 crew in IMC takes evasive action after receiving tcasii RA on approach to dfw.
Acr turbojet aircraft overshot alt on descent in ZAU airspace.
A westwind 1124 in initial climb at 10000 ft declared an emer and diverted due to a nose landing gear unsafe light caused by the failure to connect the apex bolt on the nose gear scissors.

Md80 FLC overshot clred alt in descent in dfw airspace.
Pa31 pilot at vis CTAF announced intention to cross the runway. As the pilot started to enter the runway; he looked again and saw aircraft about to land.
Flight attendant report regarding smoke in cabin just after takeoff. Cockpit informed and aircraft returned to departure airport.
A climbing mlg crosses sjc VOR at 14000 ft versus the required 12000 ft as displayed on the SID. Crew thought they were clred sjc '12000 ft or above.'

Atc controller asked B737 crew to maintain 180 kias. Crew replied affirmative. Just before the approach fix; the crew slowed to 130 kias.
Flc of a saab 340 has a taxiway excursion due to weather conditions; night op and poor taxiway markings.

Throttle locked at cruise pwr. Could not change pwr on left engine. Inflt engine shutdown. Diverted to nearest airport.
Md80 crew inbound to iah via STAR given expedited clearance for descent to 10000 ft. During descent; controller; in a combined xmission; may have changed alt to 11000 ft and a speed of 250 kias.
Aircraft crossed active runway without clearance.

The crew was issued a descent clearance which the captain and FO heard different alts. The captain read back the wrong alt and neither the controller nor the FO noticed the error. The controller alerted the crew when they were passing 1000 ft below the assigned alt and then issued a new alt.
An AC14 pilot experiences an unauthorized penetration of airspace; the class d of myf after a no handoff from san approach.

After liftoff of a B737-500; #1 engine ingested bird. Returned to airport at hou. Suspected engine damage.
Pa41 pilot was unable to obtain an IFR clearance from mia fss.

Pilot of an aero commander 200 (AC20) lost control of the aircraft during engine start when the engine started with full pwr and traveled across a taxiway and a parallel runway before the pilot could regain control by pulling back the throttle and mixture control.

Captain of a B757 on a maintenance test flight turned early during a SID departure by mistaking a heading change for prop aircraft and not turbojet type aircraft. Departure controller intervened and turned him back to desired track.

C182 pilot encountered weather and had VHF communication problem. Landed at mod; no communication.
B737 crew dsnded below 12000 ft at tejay intersection on the paradise 2 arrival to lax.

text: Nmac. Student pilot of a C172 dsnded to avoid a collision with a C152 while on the downwind leg for a touch-and-go landing. The C152 was instructed by tower to fly over the airport and enter a downwind leg for the other parallel runway.

Pilot of an experimental twin jet aircraft with 3 pax seats was climbing through FL184 when the cockpit canopy separated from the aircraft. All loose personal papers and other items were also blown out. Some caught on the horiz stabilizer. Artcc controller vectored him to a nearby airport after the reporter declared an emer.

Pilot of a robinson R22 heli flew through class c airspace during a pwr line patrol without contacting approach control. He was not fully aware of his exact position due to not having any radio navigation equip aboard. He learned of his error just prior to leaving the airspace.

text: Dc9 landing gear did not extend normally. The landing gear was manually extended. Additional problems of not being able to verify the nose gear locked down and a malfunctioning gear door light complicated the situation.

Captain of a DC9-30 declared an emer and return land after the right engine failed to respond to pwr changes during departure initial climb. The engine was shut down inflt and fuel burned off for landing.
An acr B737-300 landing at hpn uses unicom for traffic information and another aircraft uses CTAF. Neither aircraft is communicating with the other while in the traffic pattern.

Flc of a B757 were confused on descent request resulting in starting their descent only a short descent prior to the fix after ATC inquired about when they were going to descend. After dsnding at high rate; ATC stopped their descent for traffic passing below them which they observed on their tcasii.
C550 crew receives 2 tcasii traffic alerts while climbing in phx class b airspace.

Instructor pilot of a C172 gives student pilot simulated emer landing over a wide open field area while being with approach controller for VFR advisories. Since approach controller is not aware of them circling down low out of radar coverage for practice forced landings; the controller intervenes when the aircraft is climbing back up and questions alt and cancels radar ta svc.
Dc9 crew did not do the appropriate chklist before engine start. They had a wet start; and then they had an engine tailpipe fire.

Nurse during an ems flight in an A109C max twin heli heard flapping noise and notified pilot who diverted to land to find cause. Postflt inspection found that 2 of the 4 fuel access doors were unlatched and opened. The doors were closed properly; and since no damage was observed; the flight continued to dest.

Fo of a canadair regional jet CL65 passed out during cruise while computing the aircraft estimated landing wt. The captain roused him by saying his name and informed him after he responded that he had been out for 30 seconds. He advised the captain that he did not feel any adverse symptoms and could perform his duties normally. The flight continued to dest.
B737 crew inbound to tpa missed a turn on the STAR to the airport.
An sma pilot gets disoriented when getting a vector to geu. The ADF said go w and the loran said go e. Pilot could not discern the airport from the surrounding terrain.
Nmac. Pilot of an ems bell long ranger twin 407 (BH06) banks left to avoid a single engine cessna coming on a collision course during climb to a nearby hospital.
Fo of a saab SF340 (SF34-left) overshot climb alt and was noticed and corrected by the captain within 300 ft. Atc did not comment.
Fo of an embraer EMB145 overshot assigned departure alt and immediately corrected back after discovering his mistake.

Pilot of an ems smt twin return land shortly after departure due to rough running engine due to unexplained low fuel flow. Pilot previously aborted takeoff due to low fuel flow of same engine; but took off after it seemed to react normally.
B727 cargo crew had alt excursion on descent.

Fo of an embraer EMB120 (E120) failed to descend in timely rate to make descent assigned alt XING restr. Fo was informed prior to the restr; but did not start a sufficient rate of descent to assure meeting the XING restr. The captain; who was giving the FO an ioe and distr by other tasks; had not monitored the restr status.
Captain of an mlg exceeded the airspd restr below 10000 ft during descent arrival due to being distr in approach cockpit briefing.

Fo of an ltt turboprop started turning after takeoff in the opposite direction than assigned by tower. The captain and tower controller reminded the FO to turn the other way which he subsequently did without further conflict.

Nmac. Pilot of a mooney M20E (MO21) during cruise flight in class c airspace made a right turn to avoid unknown traffic 300 ft to his left. Departure controller made ta after its passing and informed the pilot that he should not deviate from assigned heading when operating in class c airspace.
Ea30 (A300) crew was required to shut down #1 engine.
B727 cabin attendant crew did not give pax briefing on a pax charter flight.
A B727-200 had the emer equip in an unsvcable overhead bin relocated in the cabin deferred with no MEL ref requirements or procedures.
Cl65 crew has respiratory problems and loss of voice after flight in a CL65 in which chemical odor was smelled throughout the aircraft.
Flc of a B727 has throttle stuck at 80% pwr on descent. Consultation with maintenance offers no solution; so engine shut down.
Flc of an A320 fails to make the XING restr assigned. 100 kt tailwind is the reason.
Flc of DC10 in descent fails to make their XING restr. They were not able to notify ATC in advance.

Pilot of a PA28-161 has close encounter with a skydiver when making an approach to a controlled field. They came within 1000 ft of each other.
Ga pilot of small aircraft possibly entered class c airspace without permission at ont; ca.

text: Artcc radar controller issued wrong direction turn to FLC of an light since both heard clearance and turned accordingly. However; controller came back and said that the crew had turned the wrong way. There was no known traffic conflict.
Flc of an MD82 had an inflt engine shutdown during descent to final due to loss of oil and pressure to the left engine. An emer was declared and successful landing made with no further difficulty.
Dc10 crew receives tcasii RA after losing sight of traffic on approach to lax.
Dornier DO328 crew had the captain's forward windshield delaminate on clbout.

Within 1 min ARTCC radar controller issued 3 alt clearances to the reporter in an atx smt twin. One to descend; one to climb back to original alt; the third clearance to descend again to 12000 ft. The reporter spotted conflicting traffic 500 ft below at 12000 ft. He immediately made a rapid climb to eliminate any further conflict.
Pvt pilot of a C152 entered class e airspace and landed VFR when the present weather was IFR. The weather was not forecasted and the pilot had no alternate plans.
Pilot entered class b airspace without clearance.
A B727-200 had an FAA audit of a daily svc inspection and found numerous cockpit and cabin required placards missing and the galley trash container doors broken.
After the fact; the company informed the FLC they exceeded duty FAR limitations.
Atr aircraft and DH8 aircraft had nmac in sju class c airspace.
Artcc radar controller handed off traffic to approach control. The traffic at the time was not down in the approach control airspace and entered the adjacent center's airspace.

text: Pilot of an sel sma forgot to put the landing gear down resulting in landing gear up.

Fo of a B737-200 overshot assigned alt during climb caused by a last min leveloff requested by ATC causing insufficient time for the autoplt to capture the alt after a late resetting of the autoplt mcp.

Atx pilot of a cargo C210 declared an emer when turning final from base leg due loss of engine pwr. A successful on airport landing was made with no damage to the aircraft or other property. Postflt examination found no fuel in the fuel tank selected.
A B737-800 proceeds to ssm instead of flying towards buf on J95 like the flight plan says to do.

Fo of a B737-500 called out gar to captain after he had just touched down due to sighting a DC9 still on the takeoff roll ahead down the runway. The captain took off and went around keeping off the side of the runway in order to not interfere with the other aircraft's flight path.
Md80 crew had a fire warning on #2 engine. The fire warning went out. Company maintenance and acr dispatch mgr advised the crew to continue the flight.

Fo of a dehavilland dash 8-102 (DH8) overshot assigned descent alt and corrected back at once. The oversight was possible due to the failure of the autoplt to maintain the capture mode after another mode is selected.

Captain of a pvt executive jet hit the hangar during repositioning taxi due to the complete loss of the main brakes. He announced to the reporter that he had no brakes just prior to impact with the hangar. The aircraft left wing and nose baggage compartment areas were damaged.
Flc of a canadair regional jet CL65 declared an emer and landed with a 0 degree flap setting due to inability to extend the wing flaps.

Artcc radar controller provided ta to the rpting FLC of a DH8 at 15000 ft and to an MD80 level at 16000 ft. Controller asked if each aircraft had the other in sight and for them to maintain visual separation. Controller then requested the DH8 crew to climb to 17000 ft and maintain visual separation. Both flcs kept the other in sight; however; each crew was given warning commands by their respective tcasii equip when apching the other.
An S80 PIC starts his left engine prematurely without benefit of GND crew communication.
Pilot of a beech bonanza V35 inadvertently penetrated restr airspace during a xcountry VFR flight due to miscalculation of the rte and mileage.

B767 crew in the vicinity of atf had an encounter with opposite direction same alt traffic and followed a tcasii ta to climb in order to avoid the aircraft.

A GND holding B727 replies to wrong call sign and accepts clearance to cross runway 4L at bos; ma. Aircraft was on lcl controller frequency. The GND controller later informed crew of what they had done.

Safety pilot report regarding a C172 flight in which the weather worsened and turb was such that heading and alt could not be maintained.
A cruising C182 aircraft is almost hit by a twin cessna type during an nmac over dta; ut. Pf was in training for the cap mission; instructor was reviewing his mission papers.
